subject: A free video series about the Inklings
body:
I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhbumrfiq8v22up4h7pkndqpdfukbt6j850r20mg_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob4cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century's most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings--an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2ztvek4rikmfnbq776105qsq5d91uf4qp4nj31otg_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob4cdh2bs)
**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings by using this secure link now:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeqj91ddq3ldadl0fpn4k254q4m1nthr76ug9e50_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob4cdh2bs)**

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books--such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ --and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien's most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we 've created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled "The Inklings," was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today--with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**You can use the secure link below to receive instant access to "The Inklings" free video series:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmhq9fn9v6pq1vem0upgglbe7gdnetf3egfogaio_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob4cdh2bs)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings' meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today's "cancel culture."

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That's why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you'll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien met regularly with an informal literary group named the Inklings.

Now, you can examine the philosophical, theological, and literary ideas that bound the Inklings together with a free video series from Hillsdale College.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series about the Inklings using this secure link:**

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3bu7ll9h1ac173nrtb7g4c9g7fem5adsr0pqhqo_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob4cdh2bs)**

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: What the media hides about birthright citizenship
body:
Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp7icaiqqlm52ps6elr01ften9esonlamvveikmo_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob2clh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Friend of Liberty,

Did you know that America's Founders rejected birthright citizenship--the idea that someone who is born within our country's borders is automatically a citizen?

This idea--which is a misunderstanding of the meaning of citizenship--is the subject of an ongoing national debate that will have long-lasting implications for our nation.

I'm writing today to offer you a FREE issue of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale College's digest of liberty, that explains the facts about birthright citizenship.

**In this FREE issue, "Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny," you'll learn:**

* Why the Founders rejected automatic citizenship based on birthplace
* How the 14th Amendment has been misinterpreted over the years
* What reforms are needed to restore the true meaning of citizenship

Since you're a concerned citizen and an intelligent patriot, I know you'll find this issue interesting and informative. It will help equip you to engage in this critical debate.

And, if your friends and family have questions about this topic, you may want to share this _Imprimis_ issue with them.

You can receive your FREE copy of **" Birthright Citizenship and Dual Citizenship: Harbingers of Administrative Tyranny"** at this secure link:

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/birthright-citizenship-imprimis](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z8on9f3rl8ovi1abp4bnbrgcnl2o96s9rlsi3gcg_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm2ob2clh2bs)

Please don't delay! Get your free copy right away.

Warm regards,

name: American Briefing
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?

Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom.
| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z575le779ssck0v9s3vppt26rt71i88ojb0id5p8_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm6oj6cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we’ve seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z5jup1gjrd5s34v0bt4tj6mfpg574jk49mhsfmfg_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm6oj6cph2bs)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zog4i9avojkcfsp23m1bi1oii95jdiao46dm24fo_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm6oj6cph2bs)**[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhq308aiaa290gl5sskluvrcs970f2jvike949cg_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm6oj6cph2bs), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers—one from each scholar—written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhamp1pvdf05pbr9bd9hj759tid67epna80bukg0_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm6oj6cph2bs)** Thanks, Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University
---
_With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred years, Hoover’s work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: A tough question
body:
There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zjr3hber9uc1fft3lplfvvn3iojnllaj2medqk98_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gmep32c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z878415m3q7v8o8kam4kt9qk8jf3k25nudo8l99o_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gmep32c1h2bs)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, ‘01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College
---
| |
---

Your America
---

**Alarming fact: More than 48 million Americans hear so poorly that their quality of life significantly suffers as a result.**

The problem: Most wait too long to act, hoping their hearing will improve on its own. Sadly, it never does.

But now, **a game-changing device is revolutionizing the hearing aid industry,** and experts say it's the biggest breakthrough they've seen in over a decade.

It's hear.com's **new IX hearing aid.**

And it’s the perfect solution at the perfect time—when more and more people are eager to maintain their quality of life and overcome these limitations.

It’s no wonder **hear.com's IX hearing aid has taken the U.S. by storm since its release earlier this year** offering hope and unprecedented clarity to thousands across America.

What makes hear.com’s IX hearing aid so special?

It’s one of **the world’s first hearing aids with dual processing.**

This is special because it’s the first time engineers have been able to pack not one, but two state-of-the-art computer chips into a device this small.

The result? **An unprecedented amount of power and clarity.**

This means that hear.com’s IX hearing aids offer all of the usual benefits of modern hearing aids—from smartphone connectivity to Bluetooth streaming—with the added bonus of something completely new: they can process speech and background noise independently, then recombine them for **unparalleled, crystal clear sound.**

“It's not just about volume,” explains hear.com founder Paul Crusius. “It's about speech clarity. And that's precisely what IX is designed to optimize.”

In other words: **with double the power comes double the clarity—and all that in a virtually invisible design!**

subject: Why chemistry?
body:
There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

This sponsored message from Real American Reporting is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2ztamjodfcvuhebvs812fu9t58sac6uqvfa7kbt88_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm1p70clh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](https://e.realamericanreporting.com/rd/9z2z9fe3kvipb98m151d7gg7ma5f4p0folq8cl42868_rp22sh2s8i6epj4s5gm1p70clh2bs)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, ‘01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

Key aspects of the law include a statewide computerized voter registration system, and assigning a unique identifier to each voter. This system is designed to be linked with other state databases for immediate access by officials, with local registration information entered quickly. USA’s current election validity concerns are not new, but are a continuation of issues persisting since before 2002. | | Marly Hornik will be in California to present the latest data from the 2024 elections and outline USA's strategy for 2025. There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1a549eeb0f2d47eeb6cf77830671d014&_e=ggl5yZNhQgZOltPDW5XO6sZ4BB9LFm-g_UQ-aURCfaLh0mgTNbLd_XkDGUA_6n-UjGYCqbd_88qmdwpXSo-w0gqpaNrrZLPe0cK5GQeKDALhqWVBh7fnQxm55P1qhJ2-XLbI6DMKB5sX0QkC0b1k73SDiBgoJAOoNA7vBBSSQ-lmIyCmuxJHyJRMFHCoB-WCpzCv2LIPtk-d59li7i2SezhMFbSA2O5_vOilMhiEUEzpQMFK1oPt4IMDszyT0h2aLT6rwJ8BeUYfLFMRtGUkzT0Kj4RbGHVrWgxpf7ReXiO8CrNEZ14NDltU2R3iYgt5FhLb310lLg51hgpbTlCneQ3gSUBgBPzGGidqlrOmR-ikEtFn7hQmmT92J7cMEuLhAyif-57VADtGGVGrvnzMxmvmQp8lHH2umJClbDR7myQ%3D)

C.S. Lewis and J.R.R. Tolkien wrote some of the twentieth century's most beloved works of literature, including robust defenses of the Christian faith.

Today, I want to share an exclusive and free video series with you that considers Lewis and Tolkien in the context of their membership in the Inklings--an informal professor-student literary group at Oxford in the 1930s and 40s.

C.S. Lewis is best known for his Narnia books--such as _The Lion, the Witch, and the Wardrobe_ --and his apologetics, including _Mere Christianity_. Indeed, Lewis is one of the greatest Christian apologists of all time.

J.R.R. Tolkien's most renowned works are _The Hobbit_ and _The Lord of the Rings _trilogy.

That both were men of genius is indisputable. Both men also devoted countless hours to honing their craft. This included subjecting their writing to the scrutiny of their fellow Inklings, who met regularly for conversation and to read aloud from and discuss their current work.

**The Inklings are a fascinating topic of study, which is why we 've created a free online video series for you to enjoy. **

The video series, titled "The Inklings," was filmed on the Hillsdale College campus. It examines the ideas that bound the Inklings, what they accomplished, and the continuing importance of their works today--with a special focus on Lewis and Tolkien.

**[https://info.hillsdale.edu/the-inklings-cca](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/s/c/awlIpQ-giIBH8k40F8nFmr27yqe2E-t108j0ln7KSaG83CFQOA_Zm3olaSdR7iich3sugAJYx5opn_DGLCDKSbyP3c4XFE-hhMfqTugoL7qXB80egldg3hOQmlccK_L2sSDgHikk8tehggd5c-SLxxoswvcofempWzGTHuPGmx63cELyatrYvHuK2AAXyZp8oDI9dV3baQOvugyooA58n5_nJfdsAkmjh0FzdDm3TPtemC7_7QIqWRJ85Qk0KROC2L49J49dqUXjzuSGfTBwmpd6BvgmwnzZfWa0B2FFiyNy9M8_lXhrc6W4Ir2q3imFmxz8MIaaaX1qkbZESsFA_ofBDFq-L4rDbz5_ZaocMMCXBejdTVjbl4hRlvzWqv2774BgGzA6p4_OIiJNkl6cD5vEhmqo1L-gNUyOJKMwS3wWW-ZztOoRrJb3IH0t/vBfn0hDreLfN99Bxziy_iIryDEGh5Slq/6)**

Lewis and Tolkien thought the Inklings' meetings contributed significantly to their literary success. As models of civil discussion and intelligent debate, they stand in stark contrast to today's "cancel culture."

The Inklings, are therefore, worth studying not only for their great literary achievements but also because they exemplify the free speech that is essential to the pursuit of truth.

That's why Hillsdale College created a free online video series on the Inklings. I hope you'll use the secure link above and start watching it today.

Larry P. Arnn

| | Dear Friend,

There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day.

Here it is...What is true about the world?

Tough, right?

It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!).

This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world.

That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Why chemistry?

For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you.

More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life.

Like all our courses, **" The Great Principles of Chemistry"** contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners.

And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible.

Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course?

**For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below:

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/principles-of-chemistry](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/s/c/iee3448-7mn2zNZS52K005-aecU7lGbyzXX22aL6xOQLqoF2rlpSvCrRxzO6bOXTTxIDmw8u7ParPFwqfGjlT2wiEY_d3WSTue4YMf2pqXJGkVMa5INfl1lz4XaKAZTGJCIk-B2JI96leDvr1ScnaEmRgOQBIV7j-KOX21Yd8QGl6rOc5q7TOMNxfJpmBO4lSK_C781G6NdlY8WeTPX82O_3JDSSlp_eixJgIgw_MT2x2pjn04LRuwo7E9OmO1KrKmaBDl6mqcmCnFJjf3EhZzHrTqC4JMzY6ZMNxt835tdGTY6stX2FctOHN8GlNqbNOxECGtd9rk2GLY9ZQHpX3m-FminKr1uo-0MrmVu6OKxNT2GecIJciB9TxNhysEojhHTnKnvRldzt3YYYx5_213JAIn4PCzsBRoRu-njhfu0ij49KH7RSsudZLlibZ2rEf0gBvXUYsFzu5Qjbpa75ng/FlkOkAe2DMpk0WbQFUhfiAq8nHDQ9P3-/6)

The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator.

For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with **" The Great Principles of Chemistry."**

Let's promote what's true about our world together.

Warm Regards,

Bill Gray, '01

clean_body: There’s a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day. This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Friend, There's a tough question that I have to ask you on this fine day. Here it is...What is true about the world? Tough, right? It's a question mankind has asked since ancient times--since creation itself. So, if you don't know the answer, that's fine (if you do, email me because I would love to know more!). This question is especially pressing today because of the growing power modern humans have to change and manipulate the material world. That's one of the reasons we released our free online course, " The Great Principles of Chemistry." Why chemistry? For one, this course brings a core subject studied at Hillsdale College to millions of Americans, including you. More fundamentally, we study chemistry as part of our liberal arts education at Hillsdale because the sciences help us understand important aspects of reality. It helps us think about our role as humans in the world around us and reveals the framework, implications, and potential for human life. Like all our courses, " The Great Principles of Chemistry" contains stunning visuals, study guides, quizzes, and in this case, hands-on experiments. This content is especially well-suited for science teachers, homeschool parents, or lifelong learners. And our online courses are free. That's why we depend on the generosity of people like you to help us share the course with as many people as possible. Would you consider making a tax-deductible donation to help promote this course? For any donation of $100 or more, you will receive a beautiful DVD box set for "The Great Principles of Chemistry," by clicking the link below: The proper study of chemistry helps us understand the world and inspires wonder and awe at the beauty of creation and its Creator. For these reasons, please join us in helping others gain a greater appreciation for the world around us with " The Great Principles of Chemistry." Let's promote what's true about our world together. Warm Regards, Bill Gray, '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College | | Defend the Constitution PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 | _

## Senate Confirms Tulsi Gabbard as Intel Chief
The Senate [confirmed Tulsi Gabbard as director of national intelligence](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQAL_GdEb22g5QuHgNXV57JTJmIXsyNsKboPz9KddfPdJoNF_36R4oUd7-hx09r2UCBU4qkNpMS6D0nmyz-BUR0DTodWcGaztlTPPwBgfn4jD06BY3234GdD0iRG3nRRndkP_YFGijtQWjWhtuEKwyzt3WEK0RVuFCXM72u1DmB67pXV54trHsTfIP5qMK80_AKGC8rqvNc8x41Q8XMB4lEVOsAsYcmEoOSVaMz5P4LWCsmAOjfBXGKmPJK5275GeqJLcwz-FcJJdDPqukzJgSbZgjyrKuFCkkecYc9KBd3zWnX46LUqJ664RV2x4o_UbyX9NeHn4CAAD__9yncVY) on Wednesday in a 52-48 vote, with Sen. Mitch McConnell as the lone Republican opposing her. Gabbard, a former Democratic congresswoman who became a Republican and endorsed Trump in 2024, faced criticism over a past meeting with Syria’s now-deposed President Bashar al-Assad and her support for NSA whistleblower Edward Snowden. Despite initial skepticism, [she secured key GOP backing](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOqzAQAL8GOiNjbyAuXLyGLq-9Em1gDXu32Ag74fL3p1x_9Uij0XzcxhuycFz-40a-hDQabS5KG9XacUaW1wj17AORIVuTb3vrAHptbb16BOMcXUH3enIa-u4KzlKP2vUO9IQ1-7dNm9a2LRirG8DOIGh7uXQBJ7AVaJq5pKP5TBzLSkFe6UlHM6WtFr-WsufK_qvMUJnhPM8mpO9IZ37zygx7Ei485coM5XhsuxKMc1Zf9FLlIZnVgvc7HrOaUgx8bFg4RRWSSDo5LuqxryyiMkUspO5YilB9-Hk_WYRz11eglw1ZfnvKX3-e3vwEAAD__wVxafk), with supporters arguing she will refocus the intelligence community. President Trump praised her confirmation, calling her a "fearless" leader committed to national security and constitutional rights. In other confirmation news, the Senate voted Wednesday [to advance Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s nomination](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuwyAUAL8Gb1iYh-10YOjiLV07Wi_wiEkwWEDs-u-rdO980ul039f5ij74eP_ClXR1aZZC9lxI3sFs0YdzVo3VjkgSNKS7ET6UGgVAs2hwIJyiG0E_DheDKOh2UTB0xjo1WNN4_bYJ2UHXKQmiVThIVAL6fnBoFDAlyPqacvtIPtaFXDjTTrk1aW2CXmrdCoNPJicmp-M4Wpd-Ih3lzZmcthR89aYwOWX35I_MY1p9xOpT5IXyTrzm17oVvhCGuvBCJlPFfHITCHPhTzr58so2EC8UsVKTtd0OH4Ivw8iUuK_ow19O_W_PruVvAAAA___wzGrg) as Health and Human Services secretary, setting up a final confirmation vote today.
## Trump: Putin Agrees to Ukraine Peace Talks
President Trump announced that he and Russian President Vladimir Putin have [agreed to begin negotiations to end the war in Ukraine](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO6jAQQNGvsbsgZzyOoXDxmnS8dstoIGMyi2NHjgHx9yu23_pKp7hf5-lMkiTf_tPKocUygQHXGeh6O80k6T2hnkNkBraaQ-_tCdEba_US3DHGI5rBmeM8RIKL8xeIjODxegJPWsJHM9Dbvkew5oA0AKGxzg2RrmgVGp6llXr4LpLbwjG9y5Pr4VpWncLS2rYr-0_BqGBsCy-S0qcpGJeycubXrmCkeZUse6vUpGQFo-vReO-6Vh_r1m2PJrlrlO7d415JMisYdQ3z9pKUZB-8QnNbSX5p3f7a8AzwEwAA__-0MV7E) following a lengthy phone call. Trump stated that he and Putin committed to working closely on a resolution and suggested they may meet in person. While Ukrainian President Volodymyr [Zelensky confirmed a conversation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kD1v9CAQhH8N7jjBgj-uoHgbd_e2Ka3NsdgkNliwvpP_feT0aaaYkR6Nno_H9MC4xjT_x40chzyBglYqkNpMHuN6TrbxLhABmYac7s3d2l4Z0yzOK6ufYTBhUKYbjA5KqXvoW_-JdzMEaKK7aAq00dqCUTeLHaBVpm27gE9rhFXkI-dy-8ox8UJhPfOLyu2Zt2Z1C_NehfknYBQwpnPPla9JwHiBBYwKBIz6iqPKRO8qYORybLuseFa5kMTk5X5wTBLnQuQlZ1kZC8tEc-aIHHOqV0vJy-O7YEwk31gEjE1xfn_HdY2164VV84Zx_f3Gf7l6OfgJAAD__4cnapo) with Trump, it remains unclear how involved Ukraine will be in the negotiations. The announcement follows a [U.S.-Russia prisoner swap](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kDFvwyAQRn8N3rDwgXEyMHTxlq4drQs-4qswREDi5t9X6d7tkz7pPel9XZYLcuR0-8SdXAt5AQWjVCAHvazI8bWYbnWBCEh35IZJn42ZlNbd5s6n9TyZkyc_ThqvwXhDFiwC2uAt-I7dm6Zg0MNgQKveoAU0So-jDeiNFkbRyi2X_jtzahuF-MpPKr3Pexfd1tq9Cv0hYBYwH8fR-2tNdNT3L2B-TwHzQ1ZZKa1V-teVii-8c8IoW5blUSuj5CTvhWtOVCT9-A3TjQTMXXHr_eAYudpJGHXbkeOfu_3X4ungNwAA__-T32J6) and comes ahead of planned peace talks in Munich, where Vice President Vance and Secretary of State Marco Rubio will continue discussions.

New research suggests that Generation Z may be [significantly more conservative](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHOnDAQhJ_GdHsya4PvL1ykobu0KdEGL7CJsZHtXEKePiL934xGGunT6Pv2ml8kUdL2lQ72bc0zahxAI_RmDiTxmm0X_MqMbDr2vTMf1jptTLd7Y51m0s6FDzcEZ5_jENblyXYZaKQndeJvmsbe9L1Fox-WRiSrzTCMKy3WKKs5SMvl8SNLajuv8cpvLo8lH130e2tnVeaLwknhlK4z13ZPCqcbrHDSqHDq74iycm1XZIXTxgn-wk4V6q9yFqmSNqiN0sKQExxUitDGQClA2_mCtkv6eVcp8J2j8FqBCsORCwP_WaRJ2hROXfHh_C0xSh2dsno7SOL_s-0zeW-P_wIAAP__mZNxiw) than millennials, particularly in their views on marriage. Approximately two-thirds of Gen Z [consider marriage important](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FugzAQgOGnsTfQcXdAMnjowpauHdGBD3BlMAIrFX36Kt0z_9In_V-P_iEhhm3-lFVdnlKPgHUBWFTUewnx6tl6N6miklVXtXRnboHILg6GkWseGtF7CzoOLDDpbQRF4VujZIN7aYAVVRUjQcnSoDBQXTeTjEyGQX3I6Si_U9jyolO80lOPckyrjW7JeT8NfRjsDHZ6nnLtR3pFg90Q02ywm3UrfgsvOWxzkQ_d_GkP5_efEGM4m9YwzKuE-E_md4tPh38BAAD__4wSUzQ), with only 23% engaging in casual hookups, a significant decrease from the 78% reported among millennials two decades ago. This shift aligns with a broader generational pendulum swing, where values tend to cycle between liberal and conservative over time. For example, [Bible sales have surged by 22%](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFuszAUhZ_GbEaX6wtJBg__Xwl1SdWhUkfkmOvg1saRsUC8fUXUtfPR-c6n83kdrsYHP9_fTGRdXBoQsJWAslHDaHzYB6pG7ZiRVcW6OakL0QmUqibtgBoFRCNezg7pxs25I-Ns2xkFFsbK64MG2KimIVRQk-nQEKi27ZyxpAQBj76kXH8lP5eJXdjTyrm2KVZBT6U8FqH-CewF9tu21XaJaX4WbIoC-5cUI8_F5F1gXyaWv_EiV8-bwP4QENgDQiewv6aV5TEgX03Ou3xPpXCu5QfzvEgXkv2WJckD9N_fAldZj4_Nh-CX7iQI7tH48JQrf521avwJAAD__7DQa1o) in the past year, with young people leading the trend, signaling a growing interest in faith and stability, researchers say.

# [St. Valentine wasn’t just one person.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srmeuf&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Famous Figures](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srmeuf&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srmeuf&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T oday, Valentine’s Day is perhaps the most secular holiday named for a Catholic saint. What started as a commemoration of a third-century religious martyr is now a commercialized tradition of romance and candy. But even digging back into the holiday’s past, it’s unclear exactly which St. Valentine was the cause for celebration in the first place. There were up to [three saints](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srmeuf&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) named Valentine who were active in the third century CE: Religious scholars have found documentation of a man in Africa, a Roman priest, and the bishop of Terni in Umbria, Italy.
---
There’s very limited information on the African St. Valentine, and the other two have enough parallels in their mythology that they might actually have been the same person — either that, or their legends borrow heavily from one another. Both were beheaded in Rome on February 14 in either 269 CE or 270 CE on the orders of Emperor Claudius II Gothicus, and were buried on the same road. And both supposedly healed a child of their jailer from blindness, inspiring an entire household to convert to Christianity.
The Italian St. Valentines also were rumored to [perform secret weddings](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srmeuf&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), although that element of the tale was probably added later, since the day wasn’t originally associated with romance. While St. Valentine is still recognized by the Catholic Church, his feast day was removed from the General Roman Calendar, the liturgical calendar of the Catholic Church, in 1969. According to that calendar, February 14 currently commemorates St. Cyril and St. Methodius, Byzantine brothers known for preaching in Central Europe in the ninth century CE.

## Modern Valentine’s Day comes from a poem about birds.
So if St. Valentine wasn’t a particularly romantic figure, why is Valentine’s Day so lovey-dovey? For that, you can thank 14th-century writer Geoffrey Chaucer, author of _The_ _Canterbury Tales_. His poem “The Parlement of Foules,” written to celebrate the engagement of King Richard II and Anne of Bohemia in 1382, described birds choosing their mates on St. Valentine’s Day in a [satire of courtly love](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srmeuf&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Soon, members of the nobility used the bird-mating season as an excuse to write love notes, and the tradition evolved into the major shopping holiday we see today.

clean_body: Today, Valentine’s Day is perhaps the most secular holiday named for a Catholic saint. | T oday, Valentine’s Day is perhaps the most secular holiday named for a Catholic saint. What started as a commemoration of a third-century religious martyr is now a commercialized tradition of romance and candy. But even digging back into the holiday’s past, it’s unclear exactly which St. Valentine was the cause for celebration in the first place. There were up to named Valentine who were active in the third century CE: Religious scholars have found documentation of a man in Africa, a Roman priest, and the bishop of Terni in Umbria, Italy. There’s very limited information on the African St. Valentine, and the other two have enough parallels in their mythology that they might actually have been the same person — either that, or their legends borrow heavily from one another. Both were beheaded in Rome on February 14 in either 269 CE or 270 CE on the orders of Emperor Claudius II Gothicus, and were buried on the same road. And both supposedly healed a child of their jailer from blindness, inspiring an entire household to convert to Christianity. The Italian St. Valentines also were rumored to , although that element of the tale was probably added later, since the day wasn’t originally associated with romance. While St. Valentine is still recognized by the Catholic Church, his feast day was removed from the General Roman Calendar, the liturgical calendar of the Catholic Church, in 1969. According to that calendar, February 14 currently commemorates St. Cyril and St. Methodius, Byzantine brothers known for preaching in Central Europe in the ninth century CE. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Saints recognized by the Catholic Church 10,000+ | | Valentine’s Day spending in the U.S. in 2024 $25.8 billion | Valentine’s Day spending in the U.S. in 2024 $25.8 billion | | Population of Italy’s Terni province in 2000 222,859 | | Percentage of Italians who identify as Catholic 78% | Percentage of Italians who identify as Catholic 78% | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Modern Valentine’s Day comes from a poem about birds. So if St. Valentine wasn’t a particularly romantic figure, why is Valentine’s Day so lovey-dovey? For that, you can thank 14th-century writer Geoffrey Chaucer, author of The Canterbury Tales. His poem “The Parlement of Foules,” written to celebrate the engagement of King Richard II and Anne of Bohemia in 1382, described birds choosing their mates on St. Valentine’s Day in a . Soon, members of the nobility used the bird-mating season as an excuse to write love notes, and the tradition evolved into the major shopping holiday we see today. ## Y'all Street Grows With NYSE Texas
The New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) announced Wednesday that its Chicago branch would relocate to Dallas and [become NYSE Texas](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OqzAUhJ_GdEbnHJsQChe3octtt0T-A1sxdgTekLz9ilTbbDPNJ30zmq_bdNMxxbz816tX9TWXiYA6DsRRTE7H9J5k45QBN2DjFfZikB3A0DVBCTGA7PBE4ipRUO8AjTNoO-skXZqoThkQCiS6IrazgXkwRvcXpwkkMQnexVq2tgZf_Uvvc3qXp99aW9YmqVDrY2fiH6OR0XgcR2uzsSdkNJ5uRiMQoxHPqMHz7A_-Ltud77XYO_cvG3RePI87T_o72xDzwnX-BTL_FLehrqnZlHscMaW4X3omYVl1TJ8t9c9znop-AgAA__-l6mXO), making it the newest addition to "Y'all Street." This move follows recent investments by Nasdaq in nearby Irving and the formation of the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE), which is on track for an early 2026 launch. The NYSE did not specify a timeline for the move, which will depend on regulatory filings. name: Texas Organizing Project
subject: TAKE ACTION: Make calls to fight bad bills in Texas / ACTÚE AHORA: Haga llamadas para luchar contra las malas facturas en Texas
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Applying pressure against dangerous Texas GOP legislation
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bad%20Bill%20Alert.png]
Battling bad bills in the Texas Legislature is a marathon, not a sprint. From now until the end of the legislative session, it's critical that our elected state senators and representatives under the Capitol dome in Austin hear from us on legislation that endangers our communities and personal freedoms. As activity in the Texas Legislature picks up, we need your help pushing back against the following Republican-backed bills that violate Texans' rights, undermine the legal process, and threaten the wellbeing of families in our state.
Help us make some calls this week! Let’s make clear that ALL who call our state home deserve to have their full rights respected.
SB9
This bill is a direct attack on pre-trial justice, expanding the harmful use of money bail and pre-trial detention, which disproportionately hurts everyday working-class Texans who simply cannot afford to buy their freedom. Share our graphic and call your state senator to urge them to oppose this legislation. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid02UQQbTuazWuTYGSJFhnmKuSPVGDjNJcYoYZfs3X14Zfc5aFf9iyeThL4qRoaJqHQdl]
SJR1
This problematic proposed constitutional amendment would unjustly deny bail for people charged with a felony offense simply because they are of undocumented immigrant status. Share our graphic and call your state senator to urge them to oppose this legislation. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid02UQQbTuazWuTYGSJFhnmKuSPVGDjNJcYoYZfs3X14Zfc5aFf9iyeThL4qRoaJqHQdl]
For more information on how to get involved in TOP's efforts to combat these bad legislative proposals and more, email Laquita at lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
RSVP NOW:
Celebrate Black History Month with us in Houston on Feb. 22
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20TOP%20members.JPG]
Since our nation’s founding, Black Americans have been the cornerstone to its historic rise , the reason for its prosperity, and the protectors of its democracy. All the while, our communities continue to endure the many devious forms of white supremacy that seek to diminish us. While forces may try, we will never be defeated and our spirits never broken.
This Black History Month, TOP is celebrating the lives, contributions, and sacrifices of our ancestors whose tenacity has shaped us into who we are today. We invite you to join our TOP Harris County staff and members for a special community event next Saturday, February 22 in Houston.
Click here for more details and to RSVP. [https://secure.everyaction.com/pvBZtP2eEk-fU8Jizpv2hA2?emci=475fb2fe-fadd-ef11-88f8-0022482a9579]
For more information, contact Gracie at garmijo@organizetexas.org [garmijo@organizetexas.org] .
TUNE IN:
Sharing our transformative vision for how we flip the political script in Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Electorette.jpg]
TOP Co-Executive Director Brianna Brown took to the airwaves with Jennifer Taylor Skinner of The Electorette Podcast [https://www.electorette.com/] to offer TOP's on-the-ground analysis of the 2024 election in Texas , discuss how the cruelty is the point for MAGA, and share how generating hope through organizing is key to navigating this tenuous political moment.
Throughout the discussion, Brianna emphasized how unwavering solidarity and restoration will be vital to our movement's sustained success, as we aim to inspire, drive meaningful change, and effectively counter MAGA’s backwards policies.
LISTEN to the full episode on the following platforms and SHARE on social media with your friends!
Amazon Music [https://music.amazon.com/es-ar/podcasts/05c47bf9-d2c5-4cb5-b59b-a6aa6fef3fcf/episodes/615be397-b532-450b-9dac-9ab93a9bf8c7/the-electorette-podcast-will-texas-ever-turn-blue-brianna-brown-of-the-texas-organizing-project-discusses-the-power-of-black-latino-coalitions]
Apple Music [https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/will-texas-ever-turn-blue-brianna-brown-of-the/id1271131782?i=1000689891057]
Spotify [https://open.spotify.com/episode/4KC2yDQphxVWjWwb5kLpC7]
TOP Tip: Don't forget the union-made candy this Valentine's Day
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Valentines%20Day%20heart%20hands.jpg]
No matter if you celebrate Valentine's Day or not, most of us can't help indulging our sweet tooth this time of year. Check out this list of union-made sweets from the AFL-CIO, stock up, and enjoy! [https://aflcio.org/MadeInAmerica/valentines]
Español
Ejerciendo presión contra la peligrosa legislación republicana de Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/ALERTA%20DE%20MALA%20LEGISLACIO%CC%81N.png]
Luchar contra proyectos de ley perjudiciales en la Legislatura de Texas es un maratón, no una carrera corta. Desde ahora hasta el final de la sesión legislativa, es fundamental que nuestros senadores y representantes estatales electos en el Capitolio de Austin escuchen nuestras voces sobre las leyes que ponen en peligro nuestras comunidades y libertades personales. A medida que aumenta la actividad en la Legislatura de Texas, necesitamos tu ayuda para frenar los siguientes proyectos de ley respaldados por los republicanos, los cuales violan los derechos de los texanos, socavan el proceso legal y amenazan el bienestar de las familias en nuestro estado.
¡Ayúdenos a hacer algunas llamadas esta semana! Dejemos en claro que TODOS los que consideran nuestro estado su hogar merecen que se respeten sus derechos completos.
SB9
Este proyecto de ley es un ataque directo a la justicia previa al juicio, ya que amplía el uso perjudicial de la fianza en efectivo y la detención preventiva, lo que afecta desproporcionadamente a los texanos de clase trabajadora que simplemente no pueden pagar por su libertad. Comparte nuestro gráfico y llama a tu senador estatal para instalarlo a oponerse a esta legislación. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid02UQQbTuazWuTYGSJFhnmKuSPVGDjNJcYoYZfs3X14Zfc5aFf9iyeThL4qRoaJqHQdl]
SJR1
Esta problemática propuesta de enmienda constitucional negaría injustamente la libertad bajo fianza a personas acusadas de un delito grave simplemente porque son inmigrantes indocumentados. Comparta nuestro gráfico y llame a su senador estatal para instar a que se oponga a esta legislación. [https://www.facebook.com/OrganizeTexas/posts/pfbid02UQQbTuazWuTYGSJFhnmKuSPVGDjNJcYoYZfs3X14Zfc5aFf9iyeThL4qRoaJqHQdl]
Para obtener más información sobre cómo participar en los esfuerzos de TOP para combatir estas malas propuestas legislativas y más, envíe un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] .
RSVP AHORA:
Célebre el Mes de la Historia Negra con nosotros en Houston el 22 de febrero
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20TOP%20members.JPG]
Desde la fundación de nuestra nación, los afroamericanos han sido fundamentales en su ascenso histórico , la razón de su prosperidad y los protectores de su democracia. Mientras tanto, nuestras comunidades siguen soportando las muchas formas perversas de supremacía blanca que buscan disminuirnos. Aunque las fuerzas lo intenten, nunca seremos derrotados y nuestro espíritu nunca se quebrará. Este Mes de la Historia Negra, TOP celebra las vidas, contribuciones y sacrificios de nuestros antepasados cuya tenacidad nos ha convertido en quienes somos hoy. Te invitamos a unirte a nuestro personal y miembros de TOP Harris County para un evento comunitario especial el próximo sábado 22 de febrero en Houston.
Haz clic aquí para obtener más detalles y confirmar tu asistencia. [https://secure.everyaction.com/pvBZtP2eEk-fU8Jizpv2hA2]
Para obtener más información, comunícate con Gracie en garmijo@organizetexas.org [garmijo@organizetexas.org] .
ESCUCHA AHORA:
Compartimos nuestra visión transformadora sobre cómo podemos cambiar el guion politico en Texas
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Electorette.jpg]
La codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, Brianna Brown, habló con Jennifer Taylor Skinner de The Electorette Podcast [https://www.electorette.com/] para ofrecer el análisis de TOP en el terreno durante las elecciones de 2024 en Texas, hablar sobre cómo la crueldad es el punto clave para MAGA y compartir cómo generar esperanza a través de la organización es clave para navegar este momento político tenso.
A lo largo de la discusión, Brianna enfatizó cómo la solidaridad y la restauración inquebrantables serán vitales para el éxito sostenido de nuestro movimiento, ya que nuestro objetivo es inspirar, impulsar un cambio significativo y contrarrestar eficazmente las políticas retrógradas de MAGA.
¡ESCUCHA el episodio completo en las siguientes plataformas y COMPÁRTELO en las redes sociales con tus amigos!
Amazon Music [https://music.amazon.com/es-ar/podcasts/05c47bf9-d2c5-4cb5-b59b-a6aa6fef3fcf/episodes/615be397-b532-450b-9dac-9ab93a9bf8c7/the-electorette-podcast-will-texas-ever-turn-blue-brianna-brown-of-the-texas-organizing-project-discusses-the-power-of-black-latino-coalitions]
Apple Music [https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/will-texas-ever-turn-blue-brianna-brown-of-the/id1271131782?i=1000689891057]
Spotify [https://open.spotify.com/episode/4KC2yDQphxVWjWwb5kLpC7]
Consejos de TOP: No olvides los dulces hechos en casa este día de San Valentin
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Valentines%20Day%20heart%20hands.jpg]
No importa si celebras el Día de San Valentín o no, la mayoría de nosotros no podemos evitar darnos un gusto con los dulces en esta época del año. ¡Consulta esta lista de dulces elaborados por los sindicatos de la AFL-CIO, haz acopio de ellos y disfruta! [] Para obtener más información sobre cómo participar en los esfuerzos de TOP para combatir estas malas propuestas legislativas y más, envíe un correo electrónico a Laquita a lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] . RSVP AHORA: Célebre el Mes de la Historia Negra con nosotros en Houston el 22 de febrero [] Desde la fundación de nuestra nación, los afroamericanos han sido fundamentales en su ascenso histórico , la razón de su prosperidad y los protectores de su democracia. Mientras tanto, nuestras comunidades siguen soportando las muchas formas perversas de supremacía blanca que buscan disminuirnos. Aunque las fuerzas lo intenten, nunca seremos derrotados y nuestro espíritu nunca se quebrará. Este Mes de la Historia Negra, TOP celebra las vidas, contribuciones y sacrificios de nuestros antepasados cuya tenacidad nos ha convertido en quienes somos hoy. Te invitamos a unirte a nuestro personal y miembros de TOP Harris County para un evento comunitario especial el próximo sábado 22 de febrero en Houston. Haz clic aquí para obtener más detalles y confirmar tu asistencia. [] Para obtener más información, comunícate con Gracie en garmijo@organizetexas.org [garmijo@organizetexas.org] . ESCUCHA AHORA: Compartimos nuestra visión transformadora sobre cómo podemos cambiar el guion politico en Texas [] La codirectora ejecutiva de TOP, Brianna Brown, habló con Jennifer Taylor Skinner de The Electorette Podcast [] para ofrecer el análisis de TOP en el terreno durante las elecciones de 2024 en Texas, hablar sobre cómo la crueldad es el punto clave para MAGA y compartir cómo generar esperanza a través de la organización es clave para navegar este momento político tenso. A lo largo de la discusión, Brianna enfatizó cómo la solidaridad y la restauración inquebrantables serán vitales para el éxito sostenido de nuestro movimiento, ya que nuestro objetivo es inspirar, impulsar un cambio significativo y contrarrestar eficazmente las políticas retrógradas de MAGA. ¡ESCUCHA el episodio completo en las siguientes plataformas y COMPÁRTELO en las redes sociales con tus amigos! body:
Voters support a leaner, transparent government and want border security, spending cuts, and to extend Trump’s tax cuts.

| **** From the moment President Trump tapped Elon Musk and the DOGE team to expose government waste--most recently at USAID--the mainstream media and the left have tried to discredit them. Rather than relying on media spin, we decided to find out directly from voters how Americans feel about Musk's audit work, so on January 28th [we commissioned a poll](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a9ad037b/1edb9794a9ac647e "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/government-transparency-poll"). The results prove that Americans overwhelmingly support cutting reckless spending and holding Washington accountable.
Here are some key findings:
* Over **60%** believe Congress should secure the border before taking a 17-day break in April.
* **79%** of Americans support "reining in Washington's reckless borrowing and spending," including 69% of independents and 65% of Democrats.
* **71%** favor Congress considering legislation to extend or make permanent the 2017 tax cuts introduced by President Trump.
* **50.3%** believe they'll be better off in four years.
These findings show the DOGE team is delivering what Americans voted for, despite mainstream media attempts to distort the truth. Washington's spending is out of control--and the people are fed up.
**To view the full poll results, **[**visit our website.**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794a9ad037b/1edb9794a9ac6480 "https://www.teapartypatriots.org/government-transparency-poll")** Then, be sure to share these results far and wide** to combat the left's narrative that President Trump is doing something wrong by asking Elon Musk and the DOGE team to audit how government officials have been spending our money.**
**In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin __ **__** **** ************

America has faced division before, but time and again, we’ve found common purpose and come together to lift the American spirit and achieve great things.

At its core, this isn’t just about our nation - it’s about living fuller, more meaningful lives and sharing that sense of purpose with others. The challenge may seem overwhelming, but change starts with small steps. By making a positive impact in our own communities, we can begin to bridge divides and build a more hopeful future.

Thank you for all that you're doing to make a positive difference! -John

| MassGOP Slams Democrats for Prioritizing Politics Over Massachusetts Residents in $425 Million Spending Bill
---
---
| Boston, MA - Last night, the Massachusetts Senate passed yet another reckless spending bill, allocating $425 million to perpetuate the ongoing migrant crisis without implementing any meaningful reforms. Every Republican senator voted against the measure, standing firm against a bill that fails to address the humanitarian disaster unfolding across the Commonwealth.
Senate Republicans fought for commonsense amendments aimed at increasing public safety and ensuring taxpayer dollars prioritize Massachusetts residents. Each was rejected by the Democratic supermajority, exposing their true priorities.
One key amendment, introduced by Minority Leader Senator Bruce Tarr (R-Gloucester), would have required universal background checks for individuals seeking emergency assistance (EA) housing. Currently, applicants must pass a CORI check, but with many new arrivals coming from outside Massachusetts--and even outside the country--this safeguard is insufficient. Republicans sought to close this loophole and prevent taxpayer funds from being used to house individuals with criminal backgrounds. Shockingly, Democrats voted it down.
"If there was ever an example of Democrats putting politics over public safety, this is it," said MassGOP Chair Amy Carnevale. "Republicans put forward a logical, necessary measure to ensure emergency housing is reserved for law-abiding individuals. The Democrats' rejection of this amendment is appalling and indefensible."
Senator Peter Durant (R-Spencer) also proposed an amendment to prioritize homeless Massachusetts residents over newly arrived migrants. This measure would have ensured that those who have paid into the system as taxpayers receive first access to taxpayer-funded services. Once again, Democrats blocked it.
"It is unconscionable that a Massachusetts citizen who could fall on hard times is being pushed to the back of the line while the state bends over backward to accommodate an influx of migrants," Carnevale continued. "The people of Massachusetts deserve better."
Lastly, Senate Republicans sought to implement real residency requirements that could not be manipulated or circumvented. Despite Governor Healey's empty rhetoric about reform, Democrats swiftly voted this amendment down as well.
"Governor Healey and legislative Democrats talk about reform, but the reforms themselves are just show pieces to protect their image. Read the reforms and it doesn't take long to realize they're written intentionally to be manipulated," Carnevale added. "Top Democrats want to be seen as responsible stewards of taxpayer dollars, but last night's votes against commonsense amendments prove, beyond a shadow of a doubt, that they are not."
The MassGOP remains committed to fighting for public safety, fiscal responsibility, and policies that put Massachusetts residents first. The party will continue to expose the failures of Democratic leadership and push for real solutions to the state's growing migrant crisis.

Hi Peter,

We’re hearing from so many of you – more than ever before – that the news these past few weeks has been overwhelming.

We understand how you feel. There’s an open misogynist and sexual predator in the White House, our Secretary of Defense, Pete Hegseth, reportedly believes that “women should not _vote or work_ ,” Elon Musk appears to have installed “an army of 20-something men” to dismantle U.S. agencies, male legislators across America are sponsoring bills that criminalize women for accessing life-saving reproductive healthcare... and so much more.

We thought today would be a good time to share our plan to protect – and even expand – women’s political power over the next four years.

[**But first, consider chipping in $20.25 or whatever you can to help us elect more pro-choice, pro-women WOMEN to protect American women’s rights and safety over the next four years.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102050171/527934106/1701071684?refcode=EM_F_250212fwd_N_JZ_NO_15_NG_N_L2&amount=20.25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg4NDk1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY5ZDg0YzMzLTFiZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=jbl7g2OLjfkQRIio0xAtYy-_WRV6pE66itjfLu0RG4Q=)

**We have an exciting twofold strategy to increase women’s political power and improve representation starting THIS YEAR:**

1\. **We’re going to support women candidates in _underserved races_ :** These are the races you might not hear about on the news – but the outcomes impact the lives of millions of Americans. We don’t want ANY women to get left behind – no matter where they live. We’re not afraid to support candidates running in red, abortion-ban states or other unexpected parts of the country. (As you’ll see below, we know how to win in those places.)

2\. **Build infrastructure in underserved places:** The states with abortion bans happen to be the same states in which it’s incredibly difficult to run for office as a Democrat and win – and even harder to run for office as a pro-choice WOMAN and win. But the voters in those states deserve better. We’re building much-needed infrastructure in those parts of the country to serve as a strong foundation for pro-choice women launching a campaign.

You may call us crazy. American Democrats have learned to accept a status quo that means we simply won’t win in red states. Well, we’re excited to report that last cycle, 44% of Her Bold Move VICTORIES came out of RED STATES.

We believe there are plenty of reasons to be optimistic.

body:

| Peter, Governor Murphy famously promised to make New Jersey the “California of the East” and say what you will about him, but he has certainly kept _that_ promise. Time after time, we have copy-pasted California’s policy decisions onto our state. The “Freedom to Read aka Groom” Act, bans on gas vehicles, sanctuary cities... Our outcomes – from outbound moves to high taxes – have begun rivaling theirs. So is it too late to turn back from the cliff? Is our status as the “California of the East” solidified? Or is there still hope? I contend that it all hinges on the New Jersey gubernatorial race this fall (and _don’t forget_ the June primary!). ICYMI, I lay it all on in [this](https://xtz223.keap-link004.com/v2/click/1a6b044e3371967b5ea9476a866f8bd0/eJyNkMFOw0AMRP_F5yxRk4Kq3KqqqqKUHhCc0XbjNguJd-U4QKny7zgF9QQSkk_j5_HYZxAkS1LWUMCHfGZZDgkwOh89kqwCiXWXbnY7n-WzBFpPrxsOQ4Ti_OvwFZjk_C5fJCCniIo8PixXVbnbPG_LXaVktKw7_uczX2RXn_X9stzCOP5pjJ2X9Zt691AIDzhdVHu9Sp64Vb4RiX2Rpi50XaAetVw77G8CH1Np0LB1aKSxYmoU5M4T9ua9Qe2xoRezR51UaWKdbf0hMHlrwuGioO0l1RQ2RqT654UVnr6zjF9qzHy0) op-ed.

Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for re-election so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in the United States Senate. The Radical Left has him circled as a prime target to defeat in the 2026 Midterm Elections. Can he count on your support? _

subject: Jim Jordan sells Ohio out to the world’s richest man
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
You won’t believe this one—except, of course, you absolutely will.
Jim Jordan has found his latest obsession, and no surprise, it’s another billionaire who couldn’t care less about regular Americans.
He’s backing Elon Musk and the so-called Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE)—which, let’s be real, is just a billionaire’s ego trip disguised as policy.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250213_Trump_Musk_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250213_Trump_Musk_image]
Trump put Musk in charge of slashing the federal government, and within days, they shut down programs that serve millions of working families, veterans, and seniors.
It comes as no surprise that Jordan, the man who has spent years turning the Judiciary Committee into a conspiracy-fueled clown show, would cheer on another chaos agent destroying democracy.
We need leaders focused on us – not billionaire buddies. That’s why we are taking Jim Jordan on right now, but this fight needs fuel. Will you chip in $25 today so we can hold him accountable and take this fight directly to voters? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250213_Trump_Musk_link1]
First of all, let me preface this by saying I too believe in reallocating funds and cutting wasteful spending, as they were in my budget plan. If Elon was really serious about cutting waste he’d look at government contracts.
Contractors charge the government three times what they normally charge, everyone knows this. I would cut that waste, but we all know who benefits the most from those government contracts, don’t we? So the difference is what we consider “wasteful.”
Let’s break down the chaos that Musk is causing and what Jim Jordan is so gleefully defending:
Nearly 50,000 federal workers in Ohio?
Who knows if their paychecks are safe.
The 3.55 million Ohioans who rely on Medicaid?
Their healthcare is now a question mark.
The 20% of Ohio seniors who depend on Meals on Wheels?
Soon to be left without food – left without answers.
The 830,000 veterans in Ohio?
Many will see lifesaving services stalled or shut down entirely.
And what is Jim Jordan doing while this chaos unfolds? Is he fighting to protect Ohioans? Writing a bill to make life easier for working families?
Of course not.
He’s on national TV defending Elon Musk.
If Jim Jordan and Elon Musk are such good buddies, maybe Jordan should ask his new best friend when he’s going to pay his fair share of taxes or stop relying on our tax dollars to prop up his businesses.
That alone would cut down on plenty of "government waste"—instead of gutting vital programs that keep Americans fed, housed, and cared for.
This is what happens when you put an insecure billionaire with no government experience and a politician who has never passed a meaningful bill in charge of the country.
Elon Musk and Jim Jordan want to strip the government down to the studs—except when it benefits them.
We need leaders who will fight for us—not sell us out to billionaires. That’s why I’m in this fight, and why we’re building a movement to take on Jim Jordan and his ULTRA-MAGA circus.
Every single dollar makes a difference in this fight. Will you rush a contribution right now to help us go after Jordan, expose this fraud, and make sure voters know exactly what he stands for? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-c2g-post-elec?refcode=20250213_Trump_Musk_link2]
Let’s show Jim Jordan and his billionaire buddy that we’re not buying what they’re selling.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

name: Kamala Harris
subject: Difficult times
body:
The job of a leader is not to sing a lullaby and soothe supporters into a sense of complacency that everything is just fine or that it will eventually be alright. It is to tell the truth.
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/2780?t=1&akid=386%2E2563979%2EgYteKM)

The job of a leader is not to soothe supporters into a sense of complacency that everything is just fine. The job of a leader is to tell the truth.
And the truth is, these are difficult times.
Over the past few weeks, I have received a lot of emails, calls and outreach on social media from people who are deeply upset, confused and angry about what is happening in Washington, D.C. and are wondering what we should be doing in this moment.
And my answer to myself, and to everyone, is to be a part of the solution in the way it works best for you.
We all have a role to play -- big or small. For some, it is volunteering either on a political campaign or with a local organization helping those in need. It could be to donate, to run for office, to stay in touch with your local legislators, to build community online and offline...
This is not a time any of us can afford to throw our hands up. It's time to roll-up our sleeves.
And one suggestion for those who can -- for something you can do today, right now, at this moment -- is to donate to the Democratic National Committee.
They will put your donation to work immediately toward winning the next set of elections so we can flip the House and Senate to put a check on Trump's power.

Because lots and lots of donations will add up fast and ensure the DNC has the resources they need.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em250213&refcode2=386_2563979_gYteKM&akid=386%2E2563979%2EgYteKM)

Patriot,

In the early morning hours of November 2021, I was jolted out of bed by banging on my apartment door. I opened my door, wearing only my underwear, to see ten FBI agents with a battering ram, guns, and blinding white lights.

In front of my neighbors, I was spun around, handcuffed, and thrown against the hallway as they breached my home.

When they told me I could call my attorney, I unlocked my phone, only to have an FBI agent snatch it from my hands. My confidential sources and journalism notes were on my phone, now open to the federal government and the Biden Administration.

I was in a complete state of shock, and for years, I lived in fear of ending up in a federal prison because I was offered the diary of the President's daughter, Ashley Biden.

As I said then, "the process is the punishment," and our federal government dictates and controls the process.

**But we are living in new times today.**

Last week, after the FBI closed its investigation related to Ashley Biden's diary, a federal judge ordered the FBI to release the search warrant materials used against me and my journalists.

The FBI released their documents **but redacted EVERY SINGLE WORD related to their probable cause.**

[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxkz8GOmzAQgOGnMTeQPTZQDhy6jdjDtr2ucqom9pC4ZQIxdqK8fWWEctmjf3_yeJCXyY_PXrRvAuDi3SoAhP4uAG7HB4f0lz_ey-OiPspb85vrfAs_dnqHF75anMz7wMeQPlf1JtPPX7fPu3rx-FzohfehFTH6Kdf2ULhej06agnrV6s40II0uLv3J2JOFriZQLdIIsuvaZhw7o03XWA2F70FCLUFpVde6_lZh29iuM6il0a62Shi5zamQKXiLao0PDGGeubIzF1N_iXFZt48NAoaVbApU4ZXcHLMQMMz_iEZich7PYU5LTnwuAzm0kVwZ0LuST-WGhR5S5D_rnIIloQ9fpIAmg_xc4g3sJVLI50dQe7DIC_rzVegDnwQ0yHO6RqEPUBehd8vDT5Nfm1YYed5WzAvde_gfAAD__6AQkmU)
To obtain the search warrant used against me to raid my home and confiscate my electronics, the FBI presented “evidence” to a judge to obtain the search warrant, **but now, years later and under a new administration without the last name "Biden," they want to withhold their reasoning.**

**[It’s time to hold them accountable](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxkz8GOmzAQgOGnMTeQPTZQDhy6jdjDtr2ucqom9pC4ZQIxdqK8fWWEctmjf3_yeJCXyY_PXrRvAuDi3SoAhP4uAG7HB4f0lz_ey-OiPspb85vrfAs_dnqHF75anMz7wMeQPlf1JtPPX7fPu3rx-FzohfehFTH6Kdf2ULhej06agnrV6s40II0uLv3J2JOFriZQLdIIsuvaZhw7o03XWA2F70FCLUFpVde6_lZh29iuM6il0a62Shi5zamQKXiLao0PDGGeubIzF1N_iXFZt48NAoaVbApU4ZXcHLMQMMz_iEZich7PYU5LTnwuAzm0kVwZ0LuST-WGhR5S5D_rnIIloQ9fpIAmg_xc4g3sJVLI50dQe7DIC_rzVegDnwQ0yHO6RqEPUBehd8vDT5Nfm1YYed5WzAvde_gfAAD__6AQkmU), and I've decided to move forward with a lawsuit **that will expose the corruption of the FBI and the Biden Administration that chose to conduct a terror campaign against me and my team of journalists over the diary of President Biden’s daughter.

**[Will you help me hold them accountable?](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJxkz8GOmzAQgOGnMTeQPTZQDhy6jdjDtr2ucqom9pC4ZQIxdqK8fWWEctmjf3_yeJCXyY_PXrRvAuDi3SoAhP4uAG7HB4f0lz_ey-OiPspb85vrfAs_dnqHF75anMz7wMeQPlf1JtPPX7fPu3rx-FzohfehFTH6Kdf2ULhej06agnrV6s40II0uLv3J2JOFriZQLdIIsuvaZhw7o03XWA2F70FCLUFpVde6_lZh29iuM6il0a62Shi5zamQKXiLao0PDGGeubIzF1N_iXFZt48NAoaVbApU4ZXcHLMQMMz_iEZich7PYU5LTnwuAzm0kVwZ0LuST-WGhR5S5D_rnIIloQ9fpIAmg_xc4g3sJVLI50dQe7DIC_rzVegDnwQ0yHO6RqEPUBehd8vDT5Nfm1YYed5WzAvde_gfAAD__6AQkmU)**

In this post:
1. Advice from some of the country's leading whistleblower experts
2. Resources for federal employees
3. My advice to federal employees and contractors

* * *
#### Advice from whistleblower experts
I spoke with experts on whistleblowing and government oversight about what lies ahead for federal employees, and I've aggregated some key resources here for you, as well.
_Who I spoke with:_
**Jane Turner** , former FBI Special Agent, whistleblower, and whistleblower advocate, now leading editor for [Whistleblower Network News](https://substack.com/redirect/206b4f24-d14b-4438-b3bd-d0e2dd44d1a2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Tom Devine** , legal director for the [Government Accountability Project](https://substack.com/redirect/97ff2a5e-a82f-407e-9a7c-de2211c8de2d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and one of the most accomplished whistleblower attorneys and advocates in the world.
**Siri Nelson** , executive director of the [National Whistleblower Center](https://substack.com/redirect/fd6171e2-f338-4a8f-9263-2911de1d51d5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**Shanna Devine** , Director of the [Office of the Whistleblower Ombuds](https://substack.com/redirect/f072941a-271c-4fed-b57d-088eddc7de9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the US House of Representatives.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..pTy5o1SX5_Ik6j9imEmAFA1lRBHjfAb4lVOjjYOYxCU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=156631097)
_Their advice:_
1. **Contact a lawyer.** This step is critical. Whether it's to get advice about what to do if you're thinking about blowing the whistle, or if it's representation once you do, your lawyer will be your advocate and your protector. The National Whistleblower Center has [a referral program](https://substack.com/redirect/82ef0233-f980-4068-93a2-2bdc1915ce3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) you can use...

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Why is Senator McMahan opposing President Trump on School Choice?
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/trumpvsmcmahan?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, Last week, MCPP hosted Rev. Joshua Robertson of Black Pastors United for Education to help make the case for School Choice.

**Pastor Robertson’s talk was truly inspirational, and you can listen to what he said by clicking on the video below.**
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=bdf9042421&e=5703353baa "Why We Need School Choice")
---
| Following his inspirational message, the Mississippi House passed a law that would allow public to public school choice in our state, HB 1435.

**At the same time, President Trump also signalled his support for School Choice. **
---
|
---
_Trump supports School Choice in Mississippi_
| **Unfortunately, Mississippi lawmaker, Senator Chad McMahan, preferred to side with Joe Biden in opposing School Choice. **

Speaking on a local radio station, Chad McMahan lashed out at President Trump’s School Choice agenda.
---
|
---
_Senator Chad McMahan attacks Trump’s School Choice policy_
| **Over the coming weeks, powerful vested interests will be doing everything they can to block School Choice.** They do not want parent power, and they will stop at nothing to defend big bureaucracy’s million dollar budgets.

MCPP supports conservatives in the fight against bureaucracy. **We will highlight lawmakers, like Senator McMahan, when they side with the bureaucrats against the taxpayer.**

For years, lawmakers have been able to say one thing at election time and do another in the Capitol. Not any longer.

Mississippi voters overwhelmingly want more School Choice. It is time to expose the coalition of the status quo.
---
| [Forward this email to a friend!](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=0069448180&e=5703353baa "Forward this email to a friend!")
---
| |
---
Warm regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

Hi Friend,
How confident are you the Supreme Court will live up to its responsibility to uphold the constitution and make real what’s chiseled into granite above its entrance, “Equal justice under law?”
Not too much?
Yep, neither are we.
Ready to do something about it?
This is Alan Cohn from Term Limit the Court, the national campaign working with 75 members of Congress, including Adam Schiff, Hakeem Jeffries, and Sheldon Whitehouse, to end lifetime appointments to SCOTUS AND enact 18-year term limits.
Attorney General Pam Bondi is already promising if the lower courts reject President Musk’s... Sorry, Trump’s assault on the federal bureaucracy, they’ll go directly to SCOTUS.
Whose side do you think they’re on?
Trump’s radical right-wing MAGA justices have already robbed women of the right to make their own healthcare decisions. They created immunity from prosecution for him, ensuring he’d never be held responsible for his continuing lawlessness.
The MAGA justices are empowered because there’s no accountability. They can’t be fired. They can’t be voted out of office.
But they CAN be retired if we work together.
We’re building what’s needed to back candidates in the House and Senate pledging to support the TERM Act.

| | Peter, DOGE is shaking up Washington, D.C. in a way that has been badly needed for decades! President Trump made a great move in tapping Elon Musk to help spearhead the effort and they are uncovering waste, fraud, and abuse in record time. **And in Arkansas, we've been looking to root out waste, fraud, and abuse in state government from my first day in office. That's why last year we established Arkansas Forward - our own DOGE-like initiative where we have already identified $300 million of savings in taxpayer money...and we’re just getting started!** The Arkansas Forward initiative is taking a comprehensive look across all state agencies, encompassing over 300 initiatives across 15 departments. We're focusing on reforms in areas including information technology, state purchasing, state vehicle fleets, state employee compensation, and state-owned buildings. We're also renegotiating statewide contracts for better pricing. We know we can save hardworking taxpayer money, all while improving state government services. **With DOGE at the federal level, and Arkansas leading the way at the state level, I know we will significantly reduce the burden of government bureaucracy, end waste and fraud, and return more taxpayer money to the people.** Fighting for you, Governor Sarah Sanders

# [Republicans in Congress want to make it harder for married women to vote. Tell Congress to REJECT this voter suppression bill >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tbf4cb429-23e5-41f5-bb52-d3bf8d714b12/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Texas Republican Rep. Chip Roy introduced a bill in Congress that would make it harder for millions of Americans to vote, including married women who have changed their last name. The “Safeguard American Voter Eligibility” Act is a ridiculous attempt to prevent non-US citizens from voting in federal elections (they are already ineligible to do so, but Republicans continue to spread conspiracy theories that undocumented immigrants are voting en masse for Democrats). This bill would require voters to present proof of citizenship when registering to vote, such as a passport (even though nearly half of Americans don't have a passport). Other forms of accepted ID require a birth certificate with a matching name. Married women who change their names after marriage do not match the name on their birth certificate, and this bill does not include proof of name change or a marriage certificate as acceptable proof of identity, making it extremely difficult for those tens of millions of women to register to vote. This bill is blatant voter suppression under the guise of “protecting” our elections. Congress must REJECT this bill wholeheartedly and immediately. [Sign your name to demand Congress vote NO on this voter suppression bill >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T499d794c-a179-482f-93f9-06405273cbb0/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

The “Safeguard American Voter Eligibility” Act is a ridiculous attempt to prevent non-US citizens from voting in federal elections (they are already ineligible to do so, but Republicans continue to spread conspiracy theories that undocumented immigrants are voting en masse for Democrats). This bill would require voters to present proof of citizenship when registering to vote, such as a passport (even though nearly half of Americans don't have a passport). Other forms of accepted ID require a birth certificate with a matching name. Married women who change their names after marriage do not match the name on their birth certificate, and this bill does not include proof of name change or a marriage certificate as acceptable proof of identity, making it extremely difficult for those tens of millions of women to register to vote. This bill is blatant voter suppression under the guise of “protecting” our elections. Congress must REJECT this bill wholeheartedly and immediately. | | | | | | | Thank you, Left Action | | | | | | Other things you can do: Follow us on and * Follow Us | | | ---|---|--- | LeftAction Washington, District of Columbia info@leftaction.com | Having trouble viewing this email? | | | or
