Folks,
President Trump is exploiting a crisis: Using the suffering of those affected by the Los Angeles fires as a tool to push voter suppression.
That’s right – he's threatening to withhold aid to the thousands of Southern Californians who’ve lost their homes, livelihoods, and communities to wildfire unless the state government sides with him to deny thousands of voters’ rights by passing a voter ID law.
Say it loud: Disaster victims are not political pawns . California needs wildfire aid now – with no partisan, anti-voter demands attached.
Stand with us and urge Congress to do their job and deliver help to people who need it immediately >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-speaker-johnson-disaster-victims-are-not-political-pawns-2?source=013125swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions%3Frefcode%3Djaaidvictims]

California lawmakers have already passed strong protections for the state’s voting systems to ensure they’re both accessible AND secure . Adding voter ID into the mix would do nothing to secure elections, just shut thousands of eligible voters out on the basis of class and color.
Entire neighborhoods have been reduced to ash, families have been displaced, and critical infrastructure has been damaged. The road to recovery is long – and pressuring California to pass voter ID will only make it longer.

**Lana Keesling Elected Chairwoman of the Indiana Republican Party**
---
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** February 13, 2025

**Contact:** Gage Hoekstra, Press Secretary, **[ghoekstra@indiana.gop](mailto:greid@indiana.gop "greid@indiana.gop")** **INDIANAPOLIS (February 13, 2025)** – The Indiana Republican Party is proud to announce the unanimous election of Lana Keesling as the next Chairwoman of the Indiana Republican State Committee. Chairwoman Keesling, currently the City Clerk of Fort Wayne, brings a strong fundraising record to the role. She successfully laid claim to a long-held Democrat seat, becoming the city's first Republican Clerk since 1971, defeating a well-funded opponent in the process. Having served as Vice Chair of the Allen County Republican Party and Treasurer of the 3rd District Republican Congressional Committee, Chairwoman Keesling has extensive experience with grassroots organizing and is determined to be a key link between local party leaders and statewide officials. Before entering public service, Chairwoman Keesling held an executive position in a private company, managing finances, information technology, and human resources, and earning both a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration and an MBA. She also brings entrepreneurial experience to the role, having been a small business owner for ten years. Chairwoman Keesling is also a devoted wife, mother to seven children, and grandmother to eleven grandchildren. **“I am deeply honored by the trust Governor Braun and the Indiana Republican State Committee have placed to serve as our party's Chairwoman,”** said Chairwoman Keesling. **“I have always been a firm believer in our party's agenda, and I am deeply grateful to have this opportunity to grow our party and deliver for Hoosiers. As Chairwoman, my first priority will always be to listen to and represent our entire state, and I am certain that together we can create an even stronger, more collaborative, and more effective party."** Governor Mike Braun congratulated Chairwoman Keesling’s on her election, stating, **“I congratulate Lana Keesling on her election as the Chairwoman of the Indiana Republican Party. I commend the State Committee for their decision and appreciated the opportunity to work with them to find leadership for our party. Lana is a leader who understands commitment, service, and hard work. She will be a tremendous asset to our grassroots leaders and all Hoosier Republicans.”** Former Interim-Chairwoman Erin Lucas will be returning to serve as Vice Chair. ###

ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.
LOCAL CANDIDATE EVENTS
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/sam%20and%20trish.jpg]
Canvass for Sam and Trish!
*this is a place holder until the new facebook event is created*
Join us Sunday to canvass for Sam and Trish! Meet our Field Coordinator, Dom, on September 3rd at the Williamson Road Library, 12:00pm.
Located at 3837 Williamson Rd, Roanoke, VA 24012.
IN THE COMMUNITY

Without current regulations, the water contamination caused by these companies could have been so much worse. Come out to support Roanoke Valley Democratic candidates!

Door knocking will begin about 12:30 pm!
Read More [https://www.facebook.com/events/275519338709424]
Roanoke EnVision Center Kids Movie Night - Sept. 28 Fall Harvest Festival
The movie is free and there will be snacks and much more! Fall into wellness at the Harvest Festival!
Read More Celebrate the end of farm season with fun experiences for the whole family. Try new activities to support your well-being. Connect with others in a beautiful outdoor space. Free meals available with registration. This event is free and open to everyone!

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RCDC.jpeg] Join the Roanoke City Democrats!
Roanoke City Democratic Committee meetings are now in-person and open to non-members. We meet the 3rd Thursday of each month. This month we are meeting at 6 pm at the Main Library (706 S Jefferson St, Roanoke, VA 24016). Sign up for meeting reminders and other information here [https://www.roanokedemocrats.com/subscribe] .
Join us for a social hour every first Thursday of the month at Leonore Restaurant, 128 Campbell St. SW, 5-7 pm.
Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]
Meetings occur on the first Monday and third Sunday of every month in person and virtually. The goal of RYD is to help improve our community and to promote the names of Democratic candidates and policies.
Contact: YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com [YoungDemocratsRoanoke@gmail.com] to get involved!

Thank you for your support! If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to reach out to me anytime.
My very best,

Dear Neighbors, **This isn’t the message we wanted to send.** We showed up. We spoke out. We pushed for better. But despite our efforts, the council and BIDA have put Bill Evans Field on indefinite hold, handing all the power to the developer while leaving taxpayers on the hook. While the sale hasn’t officially closed, the city has given up its leverage, and now we’re stuck waiting for Creed Development to decide what happens next.
|
---
******⚾** **Strike 1: The City Gives Away Bill Evans Field**

|
---
Last year, **instead of protecting Bill Evans Field** as a public resource, the City Council handed it over to BIDA—a separate entity that operates without direct public oversight.

By doing so, they made it easier to push through deals behind closed doors while keeping the community out of the decision-making process. No independent appraisal was done, and**no competitive process took place** to determine the best use for the land. When an attempt to share a [competing option](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTUwNjEzMjkyLFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiNTc3NGJmOTM4NjYzOTQ3ZSJ9) was presented, [a confidential email](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTU0ODA3NTk4LFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiYTljYzI2YjkwNDQxOWY0ZCJ9) was sent and an [employee was fired](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTU5MDAxOTA1LFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiMDkyYWNlOWE4ZDkyOWU2MyJ9).
|
---
******⚾** **Strike 2: A Failed Deal That Should Have Ended**

|
---
[](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTYzMTk2MjExLFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiMGJhMTkzMTIwYmFjNzRjZiJ9)[BIDA moved forward with a deal to sell](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTY2MzQxOTQxLFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiNWU2ZjIwZTdlMDgxYTdmNCJ9) the land to Creed Development for apartments, despite the fact that Morehouse College had offered to renovate and maintain the field for baseball.

Then, [Creed missed its closing deadline](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTY5NDg3NjcwLFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiZWQ1YTI2MzFjNTdhNTQyMCJ9). Normally, when a buyer fails to meet their contract terms, the deal falls apart and the seller reopens the opportunity to other offers.

That didn’t happen.

Instead, BIDA stalled, refusing to move forward or reopen negotiations, allowing Creed to keep its grip on the land while the community was left with no answers.
|
---
******⚾** **Strike 3: A Resolution That Left Us Powerless**

|
---
In January 2025, [Councilwoman Jamelle McKenzie](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTcyNjMzNDAwLFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiOWYzNTY2ZDEyNWJkZmNlOCJ9) was appointed to the BIDA board, shifting control over the field’s fate.

Then, on February 12, 2025, the [council rushed through a resolution](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTc2ODI3NzA3LFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiYTRlYzkzZTNjZjEzMzMwMCJ9) that doesn’t finalize the sale but keeps the land indefinitely tied up until Creed decides what to do.
| |
---
|
---

********Below is the full text of the resolution passed by BIDA on February 12, 2025:****
A RESOLUTION OF THE BUSINESS AND INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF COLLEGE PARK, GEORGIA RATIFYING AND APPROVING THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT WITH CREED ACQUISITION COMPANY, LLC; DIRECTING THE BIDA ATTORNEY, EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, AND REAL ESTATE COUNSEL TO CONTINUE WORKING WITH CITY OFFICIALS, CREED REPRESENTATIVES, AND ANY OTHER NECESSARY PARTIES IN AN ATTEMPT TO RESOLVE AND/OR OTHERWISE CURE TITLE OBJECTIONS TIMELY RAISED BY CREED; AUTHORIZING THE AUTHORITY CHAIRPERSON AND EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR TO NEGOTIATE AND EXECUTE ANY REQUIRED DOCUMENTS AND OTHERWISE PERFORM ALL OTHER ACTS NECESSARY TO ACCOMPLISH THE INTENT OF THIS RESOLUTION, INCLUDING CONTRACT AMENDMENTS AS NECESSARY TO FULFILL BIDA’S OBLIGATION TO CONVEY CLEAR AND UNENCUMBERED TITLE TO CREED AT THE TIME OF CLOSING, WHICH SHALL BE EXTENDED TO THE DATE TITLE OBJECTIONS ARE CURED OR OTHERWISE ACCEPTED BY CREED; AND PROVIDING THAT NOTWITHSTANDING ANY OTHER CONFLICTING PROVISION IN THE AGREEMENT, IF BIDA IS UNABLE TO PROVIDE A CLEAR TITLE AND/OR PERFORM CLOSING, CREED SHALL BE REIMBURSED ITS EARNEST MONEY DEPOSIT AND ALL COSTS AND FEES, INCLUDING ATTORNEY’S FEES, IT INCURRED IN INVESTIGATING TITLE DEFICIENCIES AND ASSISTING WITH THE ATTEMPT TO CLEAR SUCH DEFICIENCIES; TO BECOME EFFECTIVE UPON APPROVAL.

|
---
**Here’s why this is a disaster for the city:**
* The city gave away its leverage. Creed has no pressure to move forward, meaning the land is now in limbo.
* Creed holds all the power. They can walk away whenever they want, keep delaying indefinitely, or renegotiate terms to their benefit.
* Taxpayers foot the bill. While we wait, we continue to pay for the field’s upkeep—and it gets worse.
* If Creed pulls out, we cover their legal fees. Hidden in the resolution is a huge financial liability:
* If Creed decides to walk away, the city is required to reimburse them for their legal fees, title research, and any other costs they claim to have incurred.
* There’s no cap on how much this could be.

**This means the people of College Park could end up paying Creed for a deal that never even happens.**
* Our city leadership voluntarily put us in a weak negotiating position.
* BIDA continues to operate as a shadow government, making land deals with no public accountability.
* **Creed has all the power, while taxpayers cover the costs.**
* If they can do this to Bill Evans Field, what’s stopping them from doing it again?

**
This isn’t the outcome we wanted, but it won’t be the last time we stand up for **fairness, transparency, and accountability.
**
To everyone who showed up, emailed, [protested](https://exeprx.clicks.mlsend.com/tj/c/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEwNTM2NTUsXCJsXCI6MTQ2MjQxNDYxOTg2MjY0ODk3LFwiclwiOjE0NjI0MTQ3MjM1NjY4MDkyN30iLCJzIjoiY2FiYzgzMjQ3YTYxMTI4MiJ9), and made their voices heard—**thank you.
**
We didn’t win this round, but** ** we will **keep fighting for a city government that truly represents us.
**

body:
Parents, Not Politicians, Should Raise Our Kids
| | |
---
| | [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019L5a3zWxw4m9HiaW9kJhzEUbsjmKxSGeDHLAihmLxZlNS-aFdnDJXTLe1FErt8cq68kfy2c8-x8IurwjSZGtasZxAeZU4i8kBzjetbx5agDzlYnS0JSVS_jAPJJ2D--sNFXLILn22jLDzA7MHFaWM-aWWFK3QTiPhbNPvtpQXtgqT9UP8JTKgk2Je21fZIhwLl55iLyCUJjjZtonvuxTwA==&c=lNQ8yk1d4ZEaRD4yH9IZnG8Iv6OfPOmhSSh8H3UdnZSfliw-RDhEig==&ch=1dHA4IG3hLAFo5oo0dwmA8QTM2C-7hgWVXm80ijUsTaLfiMD8XMuww==)
---
| Friends,
I just got back to the office after a busy morning at Linda McMahon's Senate committee hearing for Secretary of Education, and let me tell you--it was an experience I won't forget.
---
| | [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019L5a3zWxw4m9HiaW9kJhzEUbsjmKxSGeDHLAihmLxZlNS-aFdnDJXZyP4JQYGtH4BbEFJmcySE2uIVyK9N7_sjF6WoEo8-MbfV21NgtoDhDemVvehMJcXSc0JVOvRN5Uic85rFohtimkbs0rVjKDYkW-vBWz-jDDL6K3U6J9vSqwI6NsDLTHO3vwMsa4q-nff9YXLH2mjM4=&c=lNQ8yk1d4ZEaRD4yH9IZnG8Iv6OfPOmhSSh8H3UdnZSfliw-RDhEig==&ch=1dHA4IG3hLAFo5oo0dwmA8QTM2C-7hgWVXm80ijUsTaLfiMD8XMuww==)
---
| As a father of seven, it was incredibly powerful to witness firsthand the debate over something so personal--who should have the final say in our children's education: families or the government?
Hearing the discussion unfold, I couldn't help but think about my own kids. My wife and I, like so many parents across America, want them to get a real education--to read, write, and think critically.
---
| But it's hard to ignore the fact that too many in Washington think they know better than we do when it comes to raising our own kids.
Some of the Democrats on that committee even spoke as if parents shouldn't have a voice at all--like the government should be the one shaping our children's future.
This is the fight: Who should decide what's best for our children--families or the government?
But here's the good news: Linda McMahon is ready to take this fight head-on.
She stood tall today because she knows what really matters--getting politics out of the classroom and making sure kids actually learn. Reading, writing, math, science--that's what education should be about, not political games.
We need leaders who will stand up for parents, protect our children's education, and push back against Washington's overreach.
I'm excited to continue supporting Linda as she takes on this fight and makes families the priority again and all of us at APP are looking forward to working alongside her to make sure that happens.
Let's keep up the fight, for our kids and for our families.
For the Family,
---
| |
---
| Terry Schilling President American Principles Project

Donald Trump has never been known for keeping his promises--unless they serve to expand his power, his wealth, or his control. One promise he has repeated since re-entering office that we must take seriously is his declaration that the United States will "assume control" of the Gaza Strip, forcibly remove its 2 million Palestinian inhabitants, and develop the land for profit. Let's be absolutely clear--this is not a "jobs program." This is not "urban renewal." This is ethnic cleansing. This is genocide. And corporate media is not only failing to call it out but, in some cases, outright supporting it. **Let 's Address This.**

### The Wall Street Journal Advocates for Genocide
Just today, the _Wall Street Journal_ ran an article attempting to normalize forced population transfers by citing historical precedents. Its headline?
"If Indians and Pakistanis Can Relocate, Why Can't Gazans? Population transfers aren't a Trump innovation. There are plenty of examples from the 20th century."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/aa1a5ce1-49d7-4a31-82a4-46f746ef60c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This is unhinged, sociopathic propaganda designed to rewrite history and justify ethnic cleansing. The _WSJ_ wants its readers to believe that forced displacement is merely a logistical challenge--not a crime against humanity.
### Forced Displacement Is Always a Crime
The historical examples of forced population transfers cited in the _Wall Street Journal_ should not be seen as precedents to follow, but as atrocities never to be repeated. A non-exhaustive list of some of the most violent and horrific examples include:
* **The Trail of Tears (1830s):** The U.S. government forced 60,000 Indigenous people from their ancestral lands in the southeastern United States, marching them thousands of miles to "Indian Territory" (present-day Oklahoma). Thousands died from disease, starvation, and exposure. This was genocide.
* **Stalin 's Campaign of Terror (1930s-40s):** Stalin's brutal forced population transfers displacing millions of Ukrainians, Crimean Tatars, Koreans, Chechens, and other ethnic groups. > * _Killing members of the group;_
> * _Causing serious bodily or mental harm to members of the group;_
> * _Deliberately inflicting on the group conditions of life calculated to bring about its physical destruction in whole or in part;_
> * _Imposing measures intended to prevent births within the group;_
> * _**Forcibly transferring children of the group to another group. "**_
>

Trump's planned forced removal of Palestinians from Gaza directly falls under "deliberately inflicting conditions of life calculated to bring about its destruction." He is openly advocating for a crime that the world has already recognized as genocide.

Rather than unapologetically condemn Trump's fascist goals, The WSJ happily serves as the water carrier for a genocidal policy. We cannot allow this dangerous rhetoric to continue. Forced displacement is genocide. It was genocide in the past. It is genocide now. Corporate media continues to fail us--another reminder of why I am continuing to build this human rights initiative of _Let 's Address This_ with your support and trust.

name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: 2026, 2028, and beyond
body:
This is a longer email — we hope you’ll read all the way through.
---
Derek, this is a longer email about the 2024 election, where Democrats stand in 2025, and where we go from here. It’s important, so we hope you’ll stick around. Donald Trump won the presidential election in November, but that doesn’t mean our hard work was in vain. It might not feel like it, but all of our contributions — whether it was knocking on doors, making phone calls, or chipping in $5 — made a big difference. Republicans have an extremely slim House majority, and Democrats won battleground neck-and-neck Senate races because of the work we did together. That’s an important lesson. We’re already seeing the consequences of November’s election as Trump’s Project 2025 agenda comes to life — but we’re also seeing how important it is that we have as many Democrats as possible in offices up and down the ballot, willing to fight back and protect the people they serve. _Now, we need to elect more of them._ That work starts now. We need to organize early, invest in races across the country, and build the strongest possible Democratic Party to take on Trump and the GOP in 2026 and beyond. But we can’t do it without your help. Your support today powers the movement that will defend our democracy, protect fundamental rights, and elect Democrats who will fight for all of us. Every dollar helps us mobilize voters, strengthen our infrastructure, and push back against the damage Trump and his allies are already doing. We know this won’t be easy. But if we stay engaged, invest in the right places, and keep doing the work, we can win. We’ve done it before, and with your help, we’ll do it again. Thank you for staying in this fight. The Democrats **This moment demands a Democratic Party that can not only mobilize against Trump and Elon Musk’s disastrous agenda, but build the long-term infrastructure to elect Democrats at all levels of government — leaders who will check Trump’s power in their cities, districts, and states.** [**If stopping Trump’s worst policies and electing Democrats everywhere is worth a few dollars to you, we hope you’ll make a $3 contribution now to help:**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2025?amount=3&refcode=em_20250213_2778_fr&refcode2=2778_22930333_P3zFbs&akid=2778%2E22930333%2EP3zFbs) _If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly._ | | | **[Donate $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-february-2025?express_lane=true&amount=3&refcode=em_20250213_2778_fr&refcode2=2778_22930333_P3zFbs&akid=2778%2E22930333%2EP3zFbs)**

Friend, I’ll be honest... fundraising isn’t my favorite part of this job. I ran for office to get things done, **not** to send endless emails asking for support. That’s why you haven’t heard from me in a while.
I’ve been on the frontlines every day, fighting to expose corruption, hold our government accountable, and stop the radical agenda that’s threatening our freedoms. I’ve been working to secure the border, protect families, and stand up for American workers.
But now, I’ll be honest... **_[I need your help](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a0Im/?__vbtrk=Mjc1Mjk3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1Mjk3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)._**

The radical Left is pouring resources into districts like mine, and they’ll do whatever it takes to **_silence us_** , to **_stop our investigations_** , and to **_push their reckless policies_**.

I’m giving it my all, but **__[I can’t fight back without your support](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a0Im/?__vbtrk=Mjc1Mjk3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1Mjk3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_._**

If we don’t step up now, everything we’ve spent so many months fighting for might slip through our fingers.
**__[Will you help me keep fighting for you](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/a0Im/?__vbtrk=Mjc1Mjk3OjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=Mjc1Mjk3OjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_?_**

Peter, Last week, some news broke after we sent this note below on the GOP trying to overturn an election in North Carolina: _a state court rejected the Republican candidate’s attempt to invalidate over 60,000 ballots._ But this isn’t over. The GOP candidate is still refusing to concede and has appealed the ruling. Here’s A.G. Holder’s take on the ruling and what needs to happen next: _“The state trial court treated these hollow anti-democracy claims just as any court must — by rejecting them. North Carolinians have spoken through their legally cast ballots, the votes have been recounted multiple times, the state Board of Elections has rejected these claims, and now a state court has considered the issue in full and done the same.**This arrogant and dangerous attempt to circumvent the will of the people must end — now. It is simply time to accept the results of this fair election.** ”_ Keep scrolling to read A.G. Holder’s piece in _The New York Times_ for more context on how we got here. And thank you for fighting alongside us to defend free and fair elections in North Carolina and around the country. — NDRC HQ | [DONATE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102070582/527990627/-1665762292?refcode=eng_ndrc_tier1_email_AGOPEDLiftNote_email_20250213-NDRC-Tier1-AGOPEDLiftNote_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=eng&utm_content=20250213-NDRC-Tier1-AGOPEDLiftNote_&utm_campaign=AGOPEDLiftNote&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI1YWExNGY3LTM0ZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=LOlG3pBpKNGins-Kab5tYDJavE86fx-oDhzFxvzV6WM=)

body:
Today we’re celebrating nearly 50 years of friendship — and the people who show up.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102071607/527993451/1328794144?refcode=ea.d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ5OTkxMjQ4LTM4ZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oBMguvqLtQ2itTq3vF6WJV_YF2sukdloYUE0_GNUdEE=&emci=50fd86ad-22ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=4823105)
---
Hey — it’s Jane Fonda and Lily Tomlin here! When we first met, we had no idea we were about to become lifelong friends. Jane had just seen Lily’s one-woman show, _Appearing Nitely_ , in Los Angeles and was completely blown away. She had to meet the woman who had her laughing and thinking all evening. Jane thought she’d be the one starstruck, but when she walked backstage, Lily was just as surprised. What started as a moment of mutual respect and admiration grew into a lifelong friendship (we still have the admiration and respect, just to be clear!) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102071608/527993452/2105508926?refcode=ea.d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ5OTkxMjQ4LTM4ZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oBMguvqLtQ2itTq3vF6WJV_YF2sukdloYUE0_GNUdEE=) Since then, we’ve shared just about everything — film sets, inside jokes, bad hair days, good wine, and more than a few unforgettable moments. We’ve worked together on films like _9 to 5_ , _80 for Brady_ , _Moving On_ , and the hit series _Grace and Frankie_. Even after all these years, people keep saying, “Wow, you two have such great chemistry.” Well... yeah. That’s what happens when you genuinely like each other. But our friendship is more than just laughter (though there’s been a lot of that). It's about showing up. For the big moments, like the Women’s March, protesting the Dakota Access Pipeline, and holding our elected officials accountable for climate inaction. And for the small moments, like a comforting phone call or blowing off steam after a long day. We’ve always been there for each other. Our friendship has taught us the power of solidarity. We make each other stronger, smarter and braver. We tap each other on the shoulder when either of us need some course-correcting, and most of all, we have each other’s backs. We're stronger together. That’s exactly what we hope to see more of, and what JanePAC is all about — people uniting, supporting each other, and fighting for a healthy future for everyone, especially in difficult times like these. This Galentine's Day, we're celebrating the power of friendship and the importance of showing up for what you believe in. Thank you for being part of this movement and for standing with us. Happy Galentine’s Day! ❤️ Jane & Lily [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102071609/527993453/2105508926?refcode=ea.d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ms=ea.d9991248-38ea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ5OTkxMjQ4LTM4ZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=oBMguvqLtQ2itTq3vF6WJV_YF2sukdloYUE0_GNUdEE=) P.S. name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Republicans are calling for my deportation
body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20250213-1224-foote&t=1001&akid=1224%2E342411%2E2DDe6V ]Squad Victory Fund

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250213-1.LSOQkW&refcode=em20250213-1224&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=1224%2E342411%2E2DDe6V ]House Republican fundraises with petition to deport Ilhan Omar

Peter — it’s
Ilhan Omar. I’m appalled.

One of my Republican colleagues in the House, Rep. Brandon Gill, sent out
a fundraising email this week calling for my deportation, and asking his
supporters to sign a petition to make it happen.

Take a look for yourself at what he sent:

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250213-1.LSOQkW&refcode=em20250213-1224&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=1224%2E342411%2E2DDe6V ][IMG]

Reprehensible, racist, and un-American. The email went on to say that I
was “facilitating a full-scale invasion of our country," and that I am
committing “treason.”

Threatening to deport legal US citizens because you disagree with them is
fascism. Full stop. But I expect nothing less from the GOP under Trump and
Elon Musk.

Peter,
it’s clear that the far-right has been emboldened and out of control since
Trump took office.

Just look at what they are doing to our federal government.

Elon Musk is illegally slashing crucial agencies and programs while
protecting funding for his companies, like SpaceX. They’re scaling back
the core functions of our government so they can line the pockets of their
billionaire friends. It’s like the wildest dreams of the ultra-rich
finally coming true.

Our best response to the far-right in this moment is to organize all of
our people, all our resources, all of the tools we have at our disposal,
to stand against Trump’s administration.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250213-1.LSOQkW&refcode=em20250213-1224&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1004&akid=1224%2E342411%2E2DDe6V ]If that sounds like a plan to you, please, make a contribution to the
Squad Victory Fund so we can continue to fight back. We are organizing to
block Trump’s agenda in every way we can, but we need your help to get it
done.

[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/19213?c0=svfem-20250213-1.LSOQkW&refcode=em20250213-1224&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=1224%2E342411%2E2DDe6V ]Contribute ››

The far-right may be emboldened right now, but the American people are
already seeing through their extremist agenda. It’s our job to keep
exposing them each and every day.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

subject: Historic opportunity in the heart of Sonoma’s redwood forest
body:
A connected landscape is a resilient one

| | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102072664/527996515/-435492268?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-mrr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4N2VmNTJiLTNhZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gkSuf1OEG3_oMyx4tG62YgFSgC-fkJ8JH_OltK9uUDw=&emci=88cf0ab2-8ee9-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=b87ef52b-3aea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1504551)
---
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102072665/527996516/-435492268?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-mrr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4N2VmNTJiLTNhZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gkSuf1OEG3_oMyx4tG62YgFSgC-fkJ8JH_OltK9uUDw=&emci=88cf0ab2-8ee9-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=b87ef52b-3aea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1504551)
| | Dear Peter,
---
We wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news!

Right on the heels of successfully protecting Sonoma Coast Redwoods, we have another exciting opportunity in Sonoma County: A long-awaited chance to secure the 1,517-acre [Monte Rio Redwoods Expansion](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102072666/527996517/-435492268?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-mrr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4N2VmNTJiLTNhZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gkSuf1OEG3_oMyx4tG62YgFSgC-fkJ8JH_OltK9uUDw=&emci=88cf0ab2-8ee9-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=b87ef52b-3aea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1504551)—a stunning redwood forest just south of the Russian River.

This purchase will close the last remaining gap between Sonoma Coast State Park and Monte Rio Redwoods Regional Park, expanding outdoor access for the health and well-being of communities across the Bay Area and beyond. It’s the “missing link” needed to connect more than 34 square miles of redwood forest, open meadows, and streams—potential habitat for wildlife such as American badgers and California quail, not to mention threatened coho salmon.

“A connected landscape is a resilient one,” says **Sam Hodder,** League president and CEO. “Securing this property will connect a critical corridor of contiguous, conserved habitat from the Bohemian Highway to the Pacific Coast. The addition of more than 1,500 acres of new parkland will be a terrific benefit to residents and visitors, providing access to spectacular recreational trails and inspiring views of the Russian River Valley.”

This acquisition also creates an opportunity to restore the health and cultural significance of the ancestral lands of the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians and the Southern Pomo territory of the Federated Indians of Graton Rancheria.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102072667/527996518/-435492268?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-mrr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4N2VmNTJiLTNhZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gkSuf1OEG3_oMyx4tG62YgFSgC-fkJ8JH_OltK9uUDw=&emci=88cf0ab2-8ee9-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=b87ef52b-3aea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1504551)
[**This project is big: Together with our conservation partner, the Sonoma Land Trust, we’re looking to raise the remaining $4 million for this acquisition by May 30.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/102072669/527996519/-435492268?sourceid=&utm_campaign=pr-mrr&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-pr&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI4N2VmNTJiLTNhZWEtZWYxMS05MGNiLTAwMjI0ODJhOTRmNCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=gkSuf1OEG3_oMyx4tG62YgFSgC-fkJ8JH_OltK9uUDw=&emci=88cf0ab2-8ee9-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&emdi=b87ef52b-3aea-ef11-90cb-0022482a94f4&ceid=1504551)

We plan to transfer this land to Sonoma County as a future addition to Monte Rio Redwoods Regional Park—an expansion that would quadruple the park’s size. This continues a decades-long effort to restore Sonoma’s historic redwood corridor, with more than 15,000 acres already protected by the League and our dedicated supporters.

Now is the time to act, as this coveted property faces significant risk of residential development. Together with local partners and supporters like you, we can secure this essential landscape and preserve its ecological, cultural, and recreational value for generations to come.

This is a shared opportunity—a chance to be part of something much larger than any one of us. Learn more about this incredible place and how you can help.

clean_body: A connected landscape is a resilient one | | | | Dear Peter, We wanted you to be one of the first to hear the news! Right on the heels of successfully protecting Sonoma Coast Redwoods, we have another exciting opportunity in Sonoma County: A long-awaited chance to secure the 1,517-acre —a stunning redwood forest just south of the Russian River. This purchase will close the last remaining gap between Sonoma Coast State Park and Monte Rio Redwoods Regional Park, expanding outdoor access for the health and well-being of communities across the Bay Area and beyond. It’s the “missing link” needed to connect more than 34 square miles of redwood forest, open meadows, and streams—potential habitat for wildlife such as American badgers and California quail, not to mention threatened coho salmon. “A connected landscape is a resilient one,” says Sam Hodder, League president and CEO. “Securing this property will connect a critical corridor of contiguous, conserved habitat from the Bohemian Highway to the Pacific Coast. The addition of more than 1,500 acres of new parkland will be a terrific benefit to residents and visitors, providing access to spectacular recreational trails and inspiring views of the Russian River Valley.” This acquisition also creates an opportunity to restore the health and cultural significance of the ancestral lands of the Kashia Band of Pomo Indians and the Southern Pomo territory of the Federated Indians of Graton Rancheria. We plan to transfer this land to Sonoma County as a future addition to Monte Rio Redwoods Regional Park—an expansion that would quadruple the park’s size. This continues a decades-long effort to restore Sonoma’s historic redwood corridor, with more than 15,000 acres already protected by the League and our dedicated supporters. Now is the time to act, as this coveted property faces significant risk of residential development. Together with local partners and supporters like you, we can secure this essential landscape and preserve its ecological, cultural, and recreational value for generations to come. This is a shared opportunity—a chance to be part of something much larger than any one of us. clean_body: While Republicans want to slash trillions of dollars from critical programs, they found $200 billion to fund Trump’s mass deportation machine. | | | Friend, From funding freezes to defunding federal departments to trillions of dollars in budget cuts, Republicans are shutting down the government. No, this isn’t a short-term government shutdown that could happen one month from now if Congress doesn’t pass a budget resolution. This is a full-scale assault on how government serves the people, from education to healthcare to nutrition to Social Security, and much more. Yesterday, House Republicans released their budget framework, which is a massive giveaway to the billionaire class. They are seeking to cut trillions of dollars from critical programs to fund nearly $5 trillion in tax cuts for the rich and corporations. Tens of millions of people would lose their healthcare coverage as states would be forced to create Medicaid waiting lists. Tens of millions more would see their out-of-pocket expenses skyrocket as Republicans seek $230 billion in cuts to SNAP food benefits. They literally want to take food off of people’s tables and let children go hungry. Are you worried about public education? Not only does the right-wing want to abolish the Department of Education (they recently introduced a bill to do just that!) , they’re proposing $330 billion in cuts to the education budget. This attacks everything from Head Start to school meals to student loans. But guess what they’re more than happy to find money for? Republicans want to increase the Homeland Security budget by $90 billion and the Judiciary budget by $110 billion. Why? Because this will help fund Trump’s mass deportation machine. They also found a whopping $4.5 TRILLION to fund a renewal of their tax scam for millionaires, billionaires, and corporations. While the wealthy will each get hundreds of thousands of dollars in tax cuts each year, you and I get the equivalent of a cup of coffee a day. This is what a government of, by, and for the billionaires looks like. | Together, we will not stop raising our voices in opposition to the GOP attack on our communities and our democracy. # **RFK Jr. Is the Wrong Choice for HHS**
---
| [](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wfcgm-uxvo8f-kyd76rh1/)
---
| | | | Dear friend, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has officially been confirmed as Secretary of Health and Human Services—a decision that puts public health at serious risk. Despite his lack of qualifications in healthcare and his long history of spreading dangerous conspiracy theories, the Senate narrowly approved his confirmation in a 52-48 vote. RFK Jr. has spent years undermining vaccine confidence, profiting from misinformation, and eroding trust in public health institutions. This is the man now tasked with leading the largest health agency in the nation, overseeing vital programs like Medicare, Medicaid, and the CDC. Here’s what you need to know: **Unqualified Leadership:** Kennedy has no experience running a major organization, let alone one that manages over $1.7 trillion in funding annually. **Dangerous Views:** He’s repeatedly made false claims about vaccine safety, including suggesting that vaccines cause autism and that Black Americans need a different vaccine schedule due to “stronger immune systems.” **Conspiracy Theories:** Kennedy has trafficked in bizarre claims, such as COVID-19 being a bioweapon targeting specific ethnic groups and Lyme disease being a military-engineered weapon. Even some Republicans expressed deep concerns about Kennedy’s views, but most fell in line to please Donald Trump. Only Mitch McConnell, himself a polio survivor, stood up and voted against this reckless nomination. We cannot allow this level of incompetence and danger to go unchecked. Every decision RFK Jr. makes as HHS Secretary could have life-or-death consequences, especially for children and vulnerable populations. It’s clear now more than ever that elections have consequences. We must continue to organize, mobilize, and fight back against the dangerous policies of the Trump administration. [**_In these times, accountability is key. We are assigning a member of our research team tracking RFK's every move and every document to expose the damage MAGA is doing. Join No Dem Left Behind today to hold this administration accountable. That is the power we have and we will be using it with your support._**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2wfcgm-uxvo8g-kyd76rh2/) In Solidarity, The No Dem Left Behind Team

Last year, she helped the state replenish its stockpile of mifepristone, proactively protecting access to abortion medication in our state. She also joined with 20 of her fellow governors to form the **Reproductive Freedom Alliance** : a historic, nonpartisan coalition committed to protecting and expanding reproductive freedom across the nation. The governors who make up this alliance represent _**over 170 million Americans**_ collectively who can breathe easier knowing their elected officials have their back. **Because of Tina and her administration’s hard work, reproductive freedoms are safe in Oregon. But we can’t take anything for granted. We have to stay vigilant.** While the Trump administration works to eliminate abortion rights nationwide — including repealing access to mifepristone — we can count on Tina to have our backs. | | **“****A disproportionate number of illegal immigrants go to blue states, they amplify the effect of a blue state vote. My understanding is that Democrats would lose approximately 20 seats in the house if illegals were not counted in census. And that’s also 20 less electoral votes for president.**** ** **So, illegals absolutely do impact who controls the House and the presidency.”****~** Elon Musk
---
| | Fellow Conservative,Elon Musk is right. It isn’t rocket-science. It’s basic math. It’s also a ticking time-bomb set by Joe Biden and Kamala Harris – in the form of 11.5 million illegals entering our country on their watch – one which will explode shortly after President Trump leaves office in 2029.While you and I have no doubt President Trump will deliver on his promise to secure the border, this threat will not go away. The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. Whether they came because, four years ago, Kamala Harris and Joe Biden prompted them to “surge to the border” for asylum or because of blue-states offering sanctuary status, “free” health care, “free” cell phones, “free” housing, and “free” college...it doesn’t matter. The result is the same.Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in Congress. Your vote is _already_ being **watered down** in the Electoral College.And every day reports are popping up of non-citizens, illegal aliens, and convicted felons being registered to vote in cities and entire swing-states across the country, which means your vote may be fully **canceled out in future elections**. **_American elections should be decided by American citizens._****[If you agree then please sign your “BAN NON-CITIZEN VOTING” Petition to Amend the U.S. Constitution so the chaos we’re seeing now _never_ happens again in America.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=c5f8b8cb986d495a809c37df1d6b1e2f&_e=5mu7XSaY8PTkvjAZV463nnxRvv-6w-Hq_YuEFl4OnEtxhTtBUqR-w6WHzusH7sF-IRyYYV03Vtplne9IFlcw58LDTYEyRZXC_szXeB0-WrZ00N7-PtnW2Paal-1erMz56ECv71hWRsESgBwk1IxWUk0f6Zwjmu2atDPWhoXqeWWw6w2felh3R1mJPBJaAXjKiTTSSK3HXwxLEBaXs3Bfw3e51-NzEwnkGzqX6vNfsggdsNVDY-ozSrAoFu3gVeuK2Dg2fYkeDQjwQqRhVFvwmCfobvGMUHzLeVxTqQqiA9oikZrLPgbThHKGsG7cPpzxGmAr4h_8A8J2CIVkDoo5GVcg4LNM8oxqhu8wx1OgFQM%3D)**Because, here’s the scary part:The last census took place in 2020. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=c5f8b8cb986d495a809c37df1d6b1e2f&_e=5mu7XSaY8PTkvjAZV463nnxRvv-6w-Hq_YuEFl4OnEtxhTtBUqR-w6WHzusH7sF-IRyYYV03Vtplne9IFlcw58LDTYEyRZXC_szXeB0-WrZ00N7-PtnW2Paal-1erMz56ECv71hWRsESgBwk1IxWUk0f6Zwjmu2atDPWhoXqeWWw6w2felh3R1mJPBJaAXjKiTTSSK3HXwxLEBaXs3Bfwwqrh2QdqnfdRF8I-qgefKUm1vC7hQXShr3FIiPhFqjwTY33vdIOCEGYulECBmiEvCwuMRW2RuJZ1e0N7mBz5ckF8kx7P70lEkkJph8Gx3He5FtMtl-sKfjI6detT6d9kubQbofuN5vEYBD3PPA2_UA%3D)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. subject: You'll want this in your home in 2025
body:
Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life...
[Unsubscribe](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xul=2qq8ny363wdaxf3eu1ztoj1l915gkh9fhngwitfxb6ee2239h6z306cka473mgng071sz8ixmcylahkj3togkw5x2ir1nntevo6pcwv19&__stmp=srn079&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith, Please -- for the sake of all our families -- take it from me as someone who's lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children. You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace. But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue's Clues_...
---
[](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srn079&__onlt=h)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses. And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to "educate" YOU about your "old-fashioned" and "mean" ideas. Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. [**Today, I'm inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great**.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srn079&__onlt=h) Introducing: _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_. I'm making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**. If you've seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we've already countered those awful "Drag Queen Story Hours" the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic "Story Hours" of our own. And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries. It's encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we're working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth. Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart. >> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we've already completed the first ten character-building episodes of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces. And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages. It was quite a moment for everyone -- including folks just like you -- who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we're making the first 5 episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE to everyone on YouTube. That's the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging. But no one will see it if we can't get the word out. And the left will try to bury _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 -- and we need to raise the funds in this first quarter of 2025.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $125,000 per episode.**_
---
I know that's a lot of money but it's actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won't work through Hollywood. Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children. We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens _must take over_ to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That's why I'm asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $125,000 per episode for Season 2.](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srn079&__onlt=h) ** As our special "Thank You" for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we'll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ _FREE on DVD_. This exclusive _Adventure with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won't be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srn079&__onlt=h)** , you'll be part of a select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You'll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor's office. So many children have no way of hearing God's message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child's life. **[**So please -- whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.**](http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=srn079&__onlt=h)** There's no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America's Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes. And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family -- not filth. Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Adventures with Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---

subject: Did you catch Ilhan’s message, Peter?

body:
[ https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250213-4761-footer&t=1001&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ]Pramila Jayapal

Hi Peter, it’s
Pramila Jayapal.

I wanted to make sure you saw yesterday’s message from my friend and
colleague, Ilhan Omar. I’ve forwarded it below, so make sure to give it a
read.

One of Trump’s MAGA loyalists in the House of Representatives sent around
a fundraising email calling for Ilhan’s deportation and asking his
supporters to sign on to a petition in support.

Ilhan’s right: It’s racist, reprehensible, and straight-up fascist. And
right now our job is to stand up and make it clear that these kinds of
threats are unacceptable in our politics.

I want to thank those of you who pitched in to yesterday’s email to show
your support. Ilhan and I were both blown away by the response, and your
grassroots donations will make a big difference as we work to grow our
progressive movement and stop the MAGA far-right.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250213?refcode=em20250213-4761&amount=3&refcode2=4761_420207_QSRzo6&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ]If you haven’t already, make sure to give Ilhan’s message a read below.
And if you can, please split a donation of $3 between both
of our campaigns to help us fight back and build a government that values
all people.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250213?amount=3&refcode=em20250213-4761&refcode2=4761_420207_QSRzo6&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Pramila Jayapal

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250213?refcode=em20250213-4761&amount=3&refcode2=4761_420207_QSRzo6&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ][IMG]

Peter —
it’s Ilhan Omar. I’m appalled.

One of my Republican colleagues in the House, Rep. Brandon Gill, sent out
a fundraising email this week calling for my deportation, and asking his
supporters to sign a petition to make it happen.

Take a look for yourself at what he sent:

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250213?refcode=em20250213-4761&amount=3&refcode2=4761_420207_QSRzo6&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ][IMG]

Reprehensible, racist, and un-American. The email went on to say that I
was “facilitating a full-scale invasion of our country," and that I am
committing “treason.”

Threatening to deport legal US citizens because you disagree with them is
fascism. Full stop. But I expect nothing less from the GOP under Trump and
Elon Musk.

Peter,
it’s clear that the far-right has been emboldened and out of control since
Trump took office.

Just look at what they are doing to our federal government.

Elon Musk is illegally slashing crucial agencies and programs while
protecting funding for his companies, like SpaceX. They’re scaling back
the core functions of our government so they can line the pockets of their
billionaire friends. It’s like the wildest dreams of the ultra-rich
finally coming true.

Our best response to the far-right in this moment is to organize all of
our people, all our resources, all of the tools we have at our disposal,
to stand against Trump’s administration.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250213?refcode=em20250213-4761&amount=3&refcode2=4761_420207_QSRzo6&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ]If that sounds like a plan to you, please, split a contribution
between my campaign and Pramila's so we can continue to fight back. We are
organizing to block Trump’s agenda in every way we can, but we need your
help to get it done.

[ https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-20250213?amount=3&refcode=em20250213-4761&refcode2=4761_420207_QSRzo6&akid=4761%2E420207%2EQSRzo6 ]Contribute

The far-right may be emboldened right now, but the American people are
already seeing through their extremist agenda. It’s our job to keep
exposing them each and every day.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

name: Sharice Davids
subject: Their priorities are skewed
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHARICE FOR CONGRESS
body:
Rural communities deserve a government that prioritizes their distinctive needs, not the desires of Washington special interests

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/102077181/528011352/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhYzlmYjQxZC00NGVhLWVmMTEtOTBjYi0wMDIyNDgyYTk0ZjQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4GBGiEKHrMN4Y7FXTps3Gzy9FTR5UG6MFvOWx5lnkEU=) It’s no secret that Kansas’ rural communities have unique needs. They have needs that, frankly, aren’t always addressed sufficiently by politicians in Washington. That’s why I’ve been particularly outspoken in Congress about supporting our state’s rural areas. Look, these communities are the backbone of Kansas’ economy. So many of our state’s farms, ranches, factories, and jobs are located in rural areas — which is exactly why I’ve worked so hard to keep these communities thriving for years to come. Throughout my time in Washington, I’ve worked to expand access to broadband internet, protect rural hospitals, and lower the cost of living — three issues that are especially critical to Kansans in rural areas. Thanks to this work, we’ve made real progress over the years. But I also know the job isn’t finished. Today, rural communities deserve a government that prioritizes their distinctive needs, not the desires of Washington special interests. But since National Republicans took full control of Washington, we’ve seen a government run _by_ special interests, _for_ special interests. **Under extreme Republican leadership, the government website that serves our rural communities even went offline!** This level of indifference to rural Kansans is particularly disappointing — but I can’t say it’s surprising. After all, it’s becoming increasingly clear that rural communities aren’t receiving the support they deserve under Speaker Mike Johnson’s leadership. Instead of coming to the table to address the urgent needs of rural families, extreme Republicans are focused on playing politics, hiking costs, and giving handout after handout to billionaires on the coasts. [_**We need to show GOP leadership that their priorities are skewed. clean_body: Rural communities deserve a government that prioritizes their distinctive needs, not the desires of Washington special interests = It’s no secret that Kansas’ rural communities have unique needs. They have needs that, frankly, aren’t always addressed sufficiently by politicians in Washington. That’s why I’ve been particularly outspoken in Congress about supporting our state’s rural areas. Look, these communities are the backbone of Kansas’ economy. So many of our state’s farms, ranches, factories, and jobs are located in rural areas — which is exactly why I’ve worked so hard to keep these communities thriving for years to come. Throughout my time in Washington, I’ve worked to expand access to broadband internet, protect rural hospitals, and lower the cost of living — three issues that are especially critical to Kansans in rural areas. Thanks to this work, we’ve made real progress over the years. But I also know the job isn’t finished. Today, rural communities deserve a government that prioritizes their distinctive needs, not the desires of Washington special interests. But since National Republicans took full control of Washington, we’ve seen a government run by special interests, for special interests. Under extreme Republican leadership, the government website that serves our rural communities even went offline! This level of indifference to rural Kansans is particularly disappointing — but I can’t say it’s surprising. After all, it’s becoming increasingly clear that rural communities aren’t receiving the support they deserve under Speaker Mike Johnson’s leadership. Here's our powerhouse slate of gubernatorial candidates for 2025 and 2026:
* **Deb Haaland (NM):** We're excited to announce our recent endorsement of Deb Haaland for governor of New Mexico. A 35th-generation New Mexican and a true trailblazer, Haaland has made history not once but multiple times, from her election to the U.S. House in 2018 to her role as secretary of the interior under President Biden. Now, she's ready to take her leadership to the next level as governor, continuing her advocacy for her community and for the rights of all New Mexicans.

* **Rep. Mikie Sherrill (NJ):** A former Navy helicopter commander and federal prosecutor, Rep. Sherrill flipped New Jersey's 11th Congressional District in one of the most competitive races of 2018. She's a champion for reproductive health care, fighting to protect Title X funding and health care access for servicewomen and military families. In 2023, she was named the most effective member of New Jersey’s congressional delegation – and we know she'll bring that same dedication and hard work to the governor's office.

* **Abigail Spanberger (VA):** Spanberger is a career-long dedicated public servant, dating back well before she flipped a U.S. House district in 2018. A former federal law enforcement officer and CIA case officer, she's spent her career defending national security and working tirelessly to protect access to health care while combatting extremist right-wing attacks on our rights. Now, she's running for governor to continue her commitment to public service and lead Virginia with integrity and courage.

* **Sec. of State Jocelyn Benson (MI):** Elected as Michigan's secretary of state in 2018, Sec. Benson has been a steadfast defender of democracy, ensuring secure and accessible elections. She's also worked tirelessly to make government services more efficient and accessible for all Michiganders. EMILYs List has proudly supported her in past elections, and we're honored to do so again in her run for Michigan governor.

And today, it's more important than ever to elect Democratic pro-choice governors who will stand up to the extremism of the Trump administration. = | = Here's our powerhouse slate of gubernatorial candidates for 2025 and 2026: Deb Haaland (NM): We're excited to announce our recent endorsement of Deb Haaland for governor of New Mexico. A 35th-generation New Mexican and a true trailblazer, Haaland has made history not once but multiple times, from her election to the U.S. House in 2018 to her role as secretary of the interior under President Biden. Now, she's ready to take her leadership to the next level as governor, continuing her advocacy for her community and for the rights of all New Mexicans. Rep. Mikie Sherrill (NJ): A former Navy helicopter commander and federal prosecutor, Rep. Sherrill flipped New Jersey's 11th Congressional District in one of the most competitive races of 2018. She's a champion for reproductive health care, fighting to protect Title X funding and health care access for servicewomen and military families. In 2023, she was named the most effective member of New Jersey’s congressional delegation – and we know she'll bring that same dedication and hard work to the governor's office. Abigail Spanberger (VA): Spanberger is a career-long dedicated public servant, dating back well before she flipped a U.S. House district in 2018. A former federal law enforcement officer and CIA case officer, she's spent her career defending national security and working tirelessly to protect access to health care while combatting extremist right-wing attacks on our rights. Now, she's running for governor to continue her commitment to public service and lead Virginia with integrity and courage. Sec. of State Jocelyn Benson (MI): Elected as Michigan's secretary of state in 2018, Sec. Benson has been a steadfast defender of democracy, ensuring secure and accessible elections. body:
Hello Shelby County Patriots,

We wanted to briefly share a few things on the horizon, and will follow up with more details in about a week.

Our next Republican Party Meeting is next Tuesday, February 18, 2025 at 6:00 pm at Calvary United Baptist Church, 9480 County Rd 25A, Sidney, Ohio 45365. More to follow!

Cheers...Dan

Peter,
Last week, I asked you all to name Black champions and leaders who have inspired you, and you listened. Seeing someone honor one of my greatest mentors, Hazel Erby, moved me deeply. She was a true St. Louis gem, and her impact will live on for generations.
Before Hazel Erby made history as the first Black woman elected to the St. Louis County Council, she was a dedicated activist, always fighting for our communities. She started as president of the Parent Teacher Organization, organizing for better schools, resources, and opportunities for our children. And when she stepped into office, she didn’t stop — she became a politivist , using her power to advocate for Black businesses, working families, and women who had long been overlooked. She led with love and conviction, and she never wavered in the face of injustice.
In fact, in 2018, she championed the legislation setting minority participation standards in county contracts, and secured funding for a North County recreation center in 2019. She also played an instrumental role in initiating youth and job development programs in St. Louis and mentoring young Black politicians — like myself.
She shattered barriers, paved the way, and inspired me in more ways than I can count. And personally, she believed in me when so many others did not. I am forever grateful. Rest In Peace, Mama Hazel. May your memory be a blessing. ❤️
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1?refcode=em_250213_hazelerby_act&refcode2=x_021325_hazelerby [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_pap_em-25q1?refcode=em_250213_hazelerby_act&refcode2=x_021325_hazelerby]
This Black History Month, I ask you to carry Hazel’s legacy forward — tell her story, uplift her name, and honor the work she did for our people. Share this email with your loved ones, and let’s continue the fight for justice together.
In love and power,
Cori Bush

body:
If you are having trouble viewing this message or would like to share it on a social network, you can [view the message online](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?gpiv=2100169480.172832.460&gen=1).

# Senator Hughes Applauds Governor Shapiro's Action to Stop Federal Freeze of $1.2 Billion
Today, Governor Josh Shapiro announced he has filed a lawsuit to challenge President Trump's unconstitutional freeze on $1.2 billion that the US Congress approved for Pennsylvania. Despite multiple court rulings that have ordered the release of the federal funds and Governor Shapiro's engagement with Pennsylvania's federal representatives -- state agencies still remain entirely unable to access $1.2 billion in federal funding, with an additional $900 million requiring an undefined review by federal agencies before it can be accessed. Senator Hughes fully supports the lawsuit. He issued the following statement to express the urgency of this matter.
* * *
**Right now, Pennsylvania can 't access over a billion dollars for home repairs, clean water, public health, and rural jobs. This money has already been approved by Congress. It is intended for programs and services that have a real impact on millions of Pennsylvania residents. The current federal disregard for our constitution and the people we serve cannot continue. ** **This lawsuit is justified and a needed step to untangle the confusion that has been caused by the Trump Administration 's federal funding freeze. We must put the lives of Pennsylvania's people first. With this lawsuit, Gov. Shapiro is doing that.** **I applaud Governor Shapiro for standing up for the people of Pennsylvania and what they need and deserve, and for standing up for the rule of law in our country. His steady leadership in this time of chaos and confusion in Washington, is exactly what Pennsylvania needs.** ** \- Senator Hughes**
* * *
If you're unhappy about the chaos and confusion coming out of Washington DC, [call your federal lawmakers.](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100169480.172832.460&gen=1&mailing_linkid=13589) Visit our website for a [complete list of Pennsylvania's federal lawmakers](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100169480.172832.460&gen=1&mailing_linkid=13589) and how you can reach them.

The truth is, without immediate action, these illegal aliens will be counted in the U.S. Census, which determines both the apportionment of seats in the House of Representatives _and_ the number of electoral votes given to each state. That was _before_ the 11.5 million illegal aliens who invaded our country under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. To put it in context, there are only 8 states in America with a population over 11 million. So, it’s as if the radical Left just imported the 9th largest state in America. That’s more than North Carolina (10.8 million), Michigan (10 million), New Jersey (9.2 million), or Virginia (8.7 million).You get the picture. That’s why urgent action is needed to pass a Constitutional Amendment to ban illegal aliens from voting and from being counted for purposes of congressional and electoral vote apportionment. The next census in less than 6 years away. If those 11.5 million illegal aliens are counted in the census or are allowed to vote in the intervening years, you and I simply won’t have a country. **[It’s vitally important that your representatives in Washington and in your state legislature hear this demand directly from you.](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=b1c68b55a62347568f54dabc2d3c96ed&_e=8iST3N0yQCJEkj6-UX7b1PRD_BMj55kpHhflq9m2hR8jVeQ7qHKpzl8Fsi5qDmsHT_dfego08Cuun_jOMJz9dpvXJ9KIO5aidn0l9SkltGHGy0m2D9yEpRPYV6cDaeZ1eu_0EYa4wXcdzktDakNvhCM3YcRVIJF6yoqoKJWGy6-SR9oF1KFGB0LNQONYrREjipbZp3K91Fm1MOw_sy7eY2_F0wNf0tBRNtSFosgzWd7quojTH_sTiwUOJvxA0CIMo2JZheZfXYOnR7jRqkaBCsXOd4sNmX2S7UmZG0_dlGS2tt2Pi17SUTKpxBpkvo2Lixk6ser066mni5wUvnOWv_bBXOJCTanSn58Tmbrx16s%3D)** Because, quite honestly, they think they can pull a fast one on you. Friend of Life,

My name is Lila Rose, and Iâm the founder and president of Live Action.

Iâm reaching out with an urgent and heartfelt request. This month, Live Action is partnering with pro-life pregnancy resource centers nationwide to provide onesies for mothers and babies in need. Will you join us for our first-ever onesie drive?

This month only, a gift of $60 will provide three custom "Wonderfully Made" onesies to three moms and their babies at risk of abortion. These onesies are more than just clothingâthey are symbols of hope and reminders that every child is a precious gift, beautifully and wonderfully made.

More than that, they symbolize the love and care each new life needs to thriveâa tangible representation of personal connection and love for both mother and baby. For mothers facing unplanned pregnancies or struggling with financial difficulties, having the basics provided can make all the difference in helping them feel supported.

Every baby is a gift that deserves to be cherished and provided for, and every mother deserves to know her baby is treasured not just by her but also by her community.

Abortion providers like Planned Parenthood rely on women feeling isolated by their unplanned pregnancies. Together, we can show these courageous women they are supported and loved by a community that values every life.

Thank you for stepping up to support mothers and their precious children. With your help, we can make a profound difference in these families' lives.

For Life,

Lila Rose

body:
Yesterday Tulsi Gabbard was confirmed as Director of National Intelligence, and today RFK Jr. was just confirmed as HHS Secretary.
#
Derek, it's John Fetterman.
Yesterday Tulsi Gabbard was confirmed as Director of National Intelligence, and RFK Jr. was just confirmed as Health & Human Services Secretary.
**I voted NO on both of their nominations.**
Pennsylvanians (and all Americans) deserve a DNI and an HHS Secretary who will focus on keeping us safe + healthy — not pushing their own agendas and undermining vaccine science.
Ultimately I’ll work with anyone where I can to get wins for PA. But if they try to do things that undermine our national security or make us sicker, you can bet I’ll speak out.
